# 迪士尼《疯狂动物城2》的创作团队带领我们重返都市丛林

![杰夫·斯普里](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2035%2035'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Jeff Spry](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/avatar_user_145_1666025815-35x35.jpeg)

|  |
| --- |
| **得到你的 [三位一体音频](//trinityaudio.ai) 玩家准备...** |

|  |
| --- |
| 这篇文章是为    **12月25日刊 Animation Magazine （编号354）。** |

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20110%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/354-Issue-Cover-Small.jpg)

[![拜伦·霍华德[宣传照]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20240%20240'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Byron Howard [publicity photo]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/byron-howard-240x240.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/byron-howard.jpg)

![拜伦·霍华德[宣传照]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20240%20240'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Byron Howard [publicity photo]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/byron-howard-240x240.jpg)

“这是迪士尼动画史上规模最大的电影，这可不是随便说说。光是角色种类就够多的了，而且不仅仅是毛茸茸的，还有穿着戏服的。我们甚至拍了一个镜头，同时在屏幕上出现了50,000万只动物！”

**——导演拜伦·霍华德**

对于我们这些上了年纪的人（或者有很酷的父母的孩子）来说，从小就读着理查德·斯凯瑞（Richard Scarry）的经典儿童读物，看着那些生活在忙碌镇（Busytown）的拟人化动物们，2016 年的动画巨作《疯狂动物城*》（Zootopia）*让我们实现了怀旧的梦想。

尽管距离迪士尼出品、拜伦·霍华德和里奇·摩尔执导（贾里德·布什和菲尔·约翰逊编剧）的奥斯卡获奖影片上映已经过去了九年，这部影片以其诺亚方舟般庞大的动物世界震撼了观众，但我们仍然对它那令人难忘的世界感到敬畏。

[![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20563'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_130.0_010.01_0303_2KR.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_130.0_010.01_0303_2KR.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20563'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_130.0_010.01_0303_2KR.jpg)

如今，曾荣获奥斯卡金像奖的导演组合霍华德和布什（*《魔法奇缘*》）携手知名制片人伊薇特·梅里诺（*《海洋奇缘2》、《超能陆战队*》），再度带来《疯狂*动物城2》* ，势必再次惊艳四座。这部由华特迪士尼动画工作室出品、耗资1.5亿美元的续集，讲述了勇敢的兔子侦探朱迪·霍普斯（金妮弗·古德温 配音）与狡猾的红狐尼克·王尔德（杰森·贝特曼 配音）联手，秘密调查一条名叫加里·德斯内克（关继威 配音）的神秘蓝蛇，这条蛇一直在动物城里制造麻烦。

“在着手制作这部电影之前，我们想做的一件事就是确保我们不仅知道我们自己兴奋的是什么，还要知道其他人兴奋的是什么，”该片联合导演、华特迪士尼动画工作室首席创意官贾里德·布什说道。 *Animation Magazine*“既然我们已经了解了动物世界，那么还有什么其他事物存在？展现它们最有趣的方式又是什么？这部电影感觉更加开阔。它美得令人难以置信，因为我们有幸与地球上最伟大的艺术家合作；他们都是各自领域的佼佼者，渴望突破一切可能的界限。”

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20566'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2_Visual_Development_Car_Chase_by_Cory_Loftis.jpg)

### [疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2_Concept-Art-of-Nick-Wilde-and-Judy-Hopps-by-Cory-Loftis-Production-Designer.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20345%20240'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2_Concept-Art-of-Nick-Wilde-and-Judy-Hopps-by-Cory-Loftis-Production-Designer-345x240.jpg)

### **动物嘉年华**

*《疯狂动物城2》*里到处都是活泼可爱的动物。布什认为这部电影拥有迪士尼电影史上最多的台词角色，数量惊人，接近70个。

“我们都是动物迷，”布什补充道。“我们热爱动物。其中一个真正有趣的事情是，尼克和朱迪一路上会遇到哪些人，这些人会给他们的关系带来乐趣，并与他们产生冲突？”

得益于皮克斯的Presto 3D软件，本作的动画质量也有了显著提升，这部趣味十足的影片必将成为好莱坞假日档期最耀眼的明星之一。《疯狂*动物城2》*的诞生离不开整个团队的通力合作。

[![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_128.0_012.00_0056.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_128.0_012.00_0056.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_128.0_012.00_0056.jpg)

“每周我们都会被他们的作品所震撼，”霍华德补充道。“这部电影规模宏大，堪称迪士尼动画史上规模最大的电影，这绝非夸张。第一部电影就已足够复杂、层次丰富、引人入胜，而这部更是如此。每个人都更上一层楼，他们的艺术造诣令人叹为观止。”

[![贾里德·布什（宣传照）](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20240%20240'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Jared Bush [publicity photo]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Jared_Bush-240x240.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Jared_Bush.jpg)

![贾里德·布什（宣传照）](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20240%20240'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Jared Bush [publicity photo]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Jared_Bush-240x240.jpg)

“我认为我们在现代拍摄这些电影时，都保留着一种老派的审美。有时候，喜剧尤其如此，其中也蕴含着一些道理。”

**——导演贾里德·布什（华特迪士尼动画工作室首席创意官）**

梅里诺指出，在华特迪士尼动画工作室工作的好处之一是，工作室的每个项目都由同一个团队负责，所以这真的是一个智囊团齐心协力做到最好的过程。

“他们在这里都非常努力，而且都是非常优秀的艺术家，”这位凭借*《Encanto》*获得奥斯卡奖的导演说道。“他们真的是各自领域里的佼佼者。我们的工作就是指导他们，给他们提供所需的资源，然后他们就放手去做了。”

才华横溢的动画团队深入《*疯狂动物城》*充满活力的世界，将故事引向这座繁华大都市中一些未曾探索过的角落。

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_240.0_015.00_0011.jpg)

### **水面之上**

“我们即将探索的最令人兴奋的新区域之一叫做沼泽市场，”霍华德分享道。“这是专为半水生和海洋动物打造的城区。我们在第一部电影里没能看到这个地方。动物们的生活方式在人类世界中是完全不同的。你去苔原镇，那里很冷，所以你要穿外套。或者你去撒哈拉广场，你知道那里会很热，所以你知道该怎么做。但是，动物们既生活在水上也生活在水下，它们需要无缝地往返于两者之间。考虑到这是动物们为自己建造的地方，它几乎就像一个外星世界。”

“这里有传送带把它们送进送出水里，”他补充道。“这里有水下和水上的建筑；还有水上酒吧。各种各样的设施都是为水生动物量身打造的。这对尼克和朱迪来说太棒了，因为他们以前没来过这里。在第一部电影里，尼克算是这座城市的‘大使’，可以带朱迪参观他熟悉的地方。他以前从没来过这里，而且这里显然不是为陆地动物设计的，所以他们处境很不利，这给我们带来了很多有趣的尴尬场面。”

[![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_120.0_216.00_0001.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_120.0_216.00_0001.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2-ONLINE-USE_120.0_216.00_0001.jpg)

布什将这个奇幻世界比作孩童时期对动物世界的想象，以及那些天马行空的图画和奇思妙想，这些都是爱做白日梦的年轻人常常沉迷其中的。“传送管道是这次故事的重要组成部分，如果你是一只海豹、海象或河马，被发射到这些管道里，那就说得通了，”他解释道。“这是从城镇一端到达另一端的完美方式。故事本身和这个世界都鼓励你尽情发挥想象力，进入更高层次的思考。”

“ *《奇幻森林》*是我记忆中第一部在电影院看的迪士尼电影，它一直让我难以忘怀，”布什说道。“那些非常有趣的角色和动听的音乐，正是我想要参与其中的原因。迪士尼拥有如此辉煌的成就并非偶然，我们也努力从中汲取经验。我认为，我们在现代创作这些电影的同时，仍然保留着一种复古的审美。有些事情，尤其是喜剧，需要遵循一定的规律。你需要正确地摆放各种元素，才能让笑料奏效，让全世界的人都喜欢。”

[![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20417'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20417'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia2.jpg)

### **Presto Perfection**

*《疯狂动物城2》*的精彩之处部分归功于动画软件从Maya升级到Presto系统，其效果令人惊艳，景深、色彩、光照效果、毛发纹理和反射表面都得到了显著提升。Presto的先进功能还促进了跨部门沟通和同步故障排除。

“这很大程度上要归功于我们的动画团队，他们积极投入并接受了Presto的改动，”梅里诺回忆道。“要改变和切换一个他们都已经习惯的系统并不总是那么容易。我们能够在同一场景中为不同的角色配音和制作动画，是因为我们可以随时切换不同的序列。这对我们来说真的很有帮助。”

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20548'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia-2-Gary-expressions-by-Sang-Jun-Lee-visual-development-artist-e1762378474852.jpg)
![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20400%20207'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/Zootopia-2-_Visual_Development_of_Gary_by_Sang-Jun-Lee-400x207.jpg)

Presto 流畅的功能对于如此庞大的项目至关重要，它允许动画师们同时工作，这是团队在使用旧版 Maya 系统时无法实现的。“这确实是我们迫切需要的，因为项目的复杂程度前所未有，”霍华德说道。“光是角色的种类就很多，而且不仅仅是毛茸茸的角色，还有穿着服装的角色。我们有一个镜头同时在屏幕上出现了 50,000 万只动物！”

“加里·德斯内克本身就是一个全新的尝试。迪士尼在动画蛇的制作方面有着悠久的传统，但我们之前从未用CG技术制作过蛇，所以这对我们来说是全新的。我非常喜欢加里，尤其是我们美术指导科里·洛夫蒂斯找到的那美丽的蓝色。还有凯的配音，那声音真是独具特色。这一切都得益于这些工具变得更加用户友好、更加灵活、更加高效。五年前，我们根本无法处理如此大规模的项目。”

**迪士尼将于11月26日在全国影院上映*《疯狂动物城2》 。***

# **全球扩张**

迪士尼寄希望于*《疯狂动物城2》在感恩节周末上映时能吸引大量观众。在2016年的**《疯狂动物城*》中奠定了朱迪和尼克的感情基础之后，拓展这个迷人动物社会的疆界似乎是顺理成章的事。

“我90年代入行做动画，那时候迪士尼几乎是独霸一方，后来梦工厂也风光了一阵子，”联合导演贾里德·布什说道。“现在动画已经全球化了，很多观众从小就接触画面精美、运用了大量电影摄影技巧和复杂渲染系统的动画，所以他们对动画的期待是存在的。但同时，他们也意识到世界动画的多元性。不同的风格、不同的处理手法、不同的叙事方式，这很棒，因为我们的团队成员背景多元，他们也希望我们能尝试这些不同的风格。”

[![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2_ONLINE-USE_950.0_015.00_0090-u.jpg)](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2_ONLINE-USE_950.0_015.00_0090-u.jpg)

![疯狂动物城2 [©2025 华特迪士尼动画工作室]](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%20419'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
![Zootopia 2 [©2025 Walt Disney Animation Studios]](https://www.animationmagazine.net/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/prev-ZOOTOPIA2_ONLINE-USE_950.0_015.00_0090-u.jpg)

迪士尼的顶尖动画师们倾尽全力，在绘图桌和电脑屏幕上精心制作了这部非凡的续集，讲述了侦探霍普斯和王尔德再次冒险进入动物城的沼泽角落，追踪一条名叫加里的狡猾蛇的故事。

“我们很幸运，身边总是围绕着这么多才华横溢的人，”联合导演拜伦·霍华德补充道。“所有参与我们电影制作的人都希望创作出经得起时间考验的作品。他们希望贡献一些可以和家人分享并引以为豪的东西。这不仅仅是一部当下流行的电影，而是十年后依然能娱乐大众的作品。每个人都希望这些故事能够尽可能地感人至深，尽可能地引人入胜。我们不断地从身边的人身上汲取灵感。”

args.summary:
# Animation Magazine独家报道：迪士尼《疯狂动物城2》深度解析

## 基本信息
- 文章出自Animation Magazine 2025年12月25日刊（第354期）
- 《疯狂动物城2》由华特迪士尼动画工作室出品，预算1.5亿美元
- 导演：拜伦·霍华德（Byron Howard）和贾里德·布什（Jared Bush，同时担任迪士尼动画首席创意官）
- 制片人：伊薇特·梅里诺（Yvette Merino，曾参与《海洋奇缘2》《超能陆战队》）
- 配音阵容：金妮弗·古德温（Judy Hopps）、杰森·贝特曼（Nick Wilde）、关继威（Gary the snake）
- 北美上映日期：2025年11月26日（感恩节档期）

## 剧情核心
故事讲述兔子侦探朱迪·霍普斯与狐狸尼克·王尔德联手调查一条名叫加里·德斯内克（Gary D'Snek）的神秘蓝蛇，该蛇在动物城制造麻烦。

## 全新世界探索
影片将引入一个全新区域——**沼泽市场（Marsh Market）**，专为半水生和海洋动物打造的城区。该区域设有水下建筑、水上酒吧和传送管道系统，为陆地动物主角带来全新的挑战和喜剧效果。

## 技术革新
- 动画软件从Maya升级到**皮克斯Presto 3D系统**，显著提升景深、色彩、光照、毛发纹理和反射表面效果
- Presto支持多角色同时配音和动画制作，跨部门协作效率大幅提升
- 本片是迪士尼动画史上规模最大的电影，其中一个镜头同时出现**50,000万只动物**
- 首次用CG技术制作蛇类角色

## 关键数据
- 影片拥有迪士尼电影史上最多的台词角色，接近**70个**台词角色
- 距离2016年第一部《疯狂动物城》上映已过去9年

## 制作团队访谈亮点
- **拜伦·霍华德**："这是迪士尼动画史上规模最大的电影，这可不是随便说说。光是角色种类就够多的了，而且不仅仅是毛茸茸的，还有穿着戏服的。"
- **贾里德·布什**："我们在现代拍摄这些电影时，都保留着一种老派的审美。有时候，喜剧尤其如此，其中也蕴含着一些道理。"
- **梅里诺**强调迪士尼动画工作室的团队协作模式，每个项目由同一团队负责，形成智囊团效应。

## 全球动画格局
布什评论道，动画已全球化，全球观众对高质量动画的期待越来越高，迪士尼团队成员的多元背景也促使他们尝试不同风格和叙事方式。

贾里德·布什 Jared Bush 也公开表示 他已经加入到这部续集的创作团队 到这个时候 可以说这部《疯狂动物城》的续集 已经正式通过迪士尼内部的评审 正式立项，进入制作环节了 2024年2月7日 迪士尼的CEO 鲍勃·艾格 官宣了这部电影的上映日期 并且确认了本片的正式片名
就是大家现在看到的《疯狂动物城2》 这个项目从最早的想法 一路走到最终定档上映 中间历经了9年的时间 从《疯狂动物城1》到《疯狂动物城2》 经过这些年的发展 整个动画行业的制作流程一直在快速地迭代 迪士尼动画也一直在持续调整和优化自己的动画制作流程 这里要特别提一下他们这次对于动画软件应用的改进 在很长的一段时间里 迪士尼动画的项目 绝大多数角色动画都是在 Maya 里完成的 但是到了近期 尤其是在《疯狂动物城2》这个项目中 他们开始改进了制作流程 对于一些经典的角色 他们的动画还是在 Maya 里去制作的 但与此同时 迪士尼的制作团队也开始把兄弟工作室 皮克斯动画 开发的内部动画软件 Presto 引入到了动画制作流程当中 让一部分角色和镜头在 Presto 里完成制作 这个软件的使用 一定程度上 解放了动画师 让他们可以把更多时间花在表演和创意上 这里简单讲一下这个 Presto动画制作软件 它本身是皮克斯动画自行开发的一套专有的内部动画系统 很多年前 皮克斯还有更早期的一套自研动画软件 叫 Menv 媒体上更常听到的名字是 Marionette 意思为“提线木偶” 在长期的项目制作里 这套旧系统逐渐暴露出一些瓶颈 在经历过一系列的升级和迭代之后 Presto动画制作软件最终诞生 《勇敢传说》（Brave）是第一部完全使用 Presto 制作角色动画的长篇动画电影 按照皮克斯自己的说法 Presto 的设计目标 是希望那些有传统赛璐珞动画经验的动画师 拿到这个软件时 就会觉得非常直观 上手快 逻辑熟悉 不需要再去额外地学习技术层面的东西 值得一提的是 Presto 这个名字来自2008年皮克斯的同名的动画短片 这个短片本身讲的就是一个叫 Presto 的魔术师的故事 某种程度上 也暗示了这套软件希望在动画制作中达成的那种“魔术感”的效果 迪士尼的动画师在塑造角色表演时 会叠加和综合多种参考来源 其中包括了他们自己拍摄的 根据剧本台词所表演的视频参考 配音演员们在配音时候的录像 以及 许多在不同时期所绘制的2D 动画草稿 在最开始设定所有动物动画行为的时候 他们的最主要目标就是尽可能地避免让观众感觉 这些动物的行为完全像是人类的行为 只是把头和身子换成了动物 套了件衣服而已 创作团队希望 在这些拟人化的角色设定中 尽量地保持动物本身的运动习惯 尤其是在一些剧情需要的时候 比如说 对于主角 兔警官 Judy 动画师们在她的一些动作里 刻意地加入了很多真实兔子的行为特征 比方说 她警觉的时候 耳朵会朝声音的方向转动、紧张的时候 鼻子会微微抽动 还有所谓的 “binkies” 就是先用四肢奔跑再突然跳起的动作 再比如说 大象在角色表演中 仍然会像用“手”一样使用鼻子 长颈鹿虽然被设计成用两条腿奔跑 但整体步态依然尽量地贴近真实长颈鹿运动的节奏和重心 为了捕捉真实的动物运动特征 动画师们还专门去了迪士尼动物王国
（Disney’s Animal Kingdom）以及 在制作的后期 动画师们还组团去了非洲的野生国家动物园进行实的考察 在制作早期 团队就创建了一批各种角色的动作循环测试 这些测试有两个作用：一方面 这些循环动画可以在整部电影中 反复地被群集动画团队拿来复用 另一方面 动画师也可以借此 来测试角色的绑定系统 同时向绑定团队反馈角色核心动作上的问题和调整方向 片中的城市设计包含了风格多样的分区 灵感分别来自旧金山、伦敦和纽约等现实城市 再加上人为制造的不同气候区 形成了一个完整的“自然生态系统” 创作者在环境细节上的极致追求 让这个世界显得非常真实和鲜活 所有的建筑环境的设计 都是以其所处在的气候区域所决定的 同时在一些街道细节上 他们也大量参考了现实中人类的世界 在《疯狂动物城》的这个世界观中 动物们的尺寸差别很大 这也给了整个团队带来了挑战 在设计城市场景和对应功能的时候 团队充分考虑到了不同尺寸动物的需求 针对性地设计了许多道具和生活环境 这些道具，很多都是可调节尺寸的 比如说办公桌的高度可以根据角色体型的变化
来适配同一个场景等等 由于《疯狂动物城2》所包括的动物种类众多 所以整部电影在毛发制作和渲染方面面临着很大的挑战 这些动物的毛发在色泽、样式和数量上 差别很大 比如说 主角 Nick 和 Judy 在毛发渲染上 都各自需要超过 200 万根毛发数据 而某只长颈鹿角色则需要多达 900 万根毛发 且它们的外观差别也很大 为了应对这种技术复杂度 团队不得不专门开发一套新的毛发材质流程来应对这些挑战 前期的 Layout 分镜布景 艺术家们 在制作的时候 需要通过构图和摄影机调度
来打造高质量的“电影感”镜头 他们会以故事版（storyboards）为起点 但在具体制作中 经常会在故事版的基础上大胆突破 加入新的故事节奏和镜头想法 从而不断丰富最终的视觉叙事 这些做好的分镜动画 很多时候 也会作为动画部门很好的参考和制作起点 接下来再说一个我个人特别喜欢的幕后故事 关继威（Ke Huy Quan）是怎么获得
那条蓝色毒蛇 Gary 的英文配音角色的 这件事的起点其实非常“偶然” 有一位正在做《疯狂动物城2》的动画师 某天看到了关继威的一个访谈节目 他特别喜欢关继威的声音 于是就把那段节目的音频截下来 然后直接拿这段访谈的音频 去给 Gary 这条蛇做了一段测试动画 并且获得了主创团队的肯定 关继威后来在接受采访的时候说 多亏了这位动画师的那段测试 他才顺利拿到了 Gary这个配音角色 最后 我们再来简单认识一下《疯狂动物城2》
的两位导演和制片人 这部电影是由两位导演联合执导的 他们分别是 贾里德·布什（Jared Bush）
拜伦·霍华德（Byron Howard） 影片的制片人是 伊薇特·梅里诺（Yvett Merino） 他们三个也算是老搭档了 在迪士尼动画前后合作过很长的时间 其中的高光时刻就是在2022年 他们三人和另外一位同事 因为迪士尼的《魔法满屋》（Encanto）这部动画电影 赢得了第94届奥斯卡金像奖的最佳动画长片 贾里德·布什（Jared Bush）也是本片的编剧 他在第一部《疯狂动物城 Zootopia》中 就曾担任过导演和编剧的职位 在《魔法满屋》（Encanto）中 他同样担任了导演和编剧 他还参与过包括《海洋奇缘》（Moana）
在内的多部迪士尼动画长片的创作 可以说是近些年来迪士尼动画故事创作的核心人物之一 本片的联合导演 拜伦·霍华德（Byron Howard）同样曾经担任第一部《疯狂动物城 Zootopia》的联合导演和编剧 也算是整个动物城世界观的创始人之一了 他除了前面提到的因为
《魔法满屋》赢得奥斯卡金像奖之外 还曾经于2017年 因为《疯狂动物城》第一部 赢得过第89届奥斯卡金像奖的最佳动画长片 并且另外获得过一次奥斯卡提名 他的从业经历非常资深 是迪士尼复兴阶段非常关键的一位导演 拥有超过25年的行业从业经验 先后参加过非常多的知名项目 其中包括了1997年的《花木兰》 以及我个人非常喜欢的动画电影《Klaus》 他在里面担任角色设计师 好啦 这期视频就是这样啦 非常感谢大家的观看 我过两天也会去看这部电影 非常期待 大家如果有什么观后感或者其他想分享的 非常欢迎大家在评论区里讨论 那我们就下期视频再见啦 拜拜

args.summary:
This video (from channel "己千坊," posted November 26, 2025) covers the behind-the-scenes story of *Zootopia 2* (疯狂动物城2), which was released around Thanksgiving 2025. The video discusses the film's development timeline, animation software improvements, artistic creation, world design, voice casting, and the directors and producer.

**Development Timeline:**
- June 2016: Directors began internal discussions about a sequel shortly after the first film's release.
- February 8, 2023: Disney CEO Bob Iger officially confirmed the sequel was in active development.
- February 7, 2024: Bob Iger announced the official title and release date.
- The project took about 9 years from initial idea to release.

**Animation Software:**
- Traditionally, Disney used Maya for character animation. For *Zootopia 2*, they began integrating Pixar's internal animation software, **Presto**, alongside Maya. Presto was designed to be intuitive for traditional animators. The first film to fully use Presto was *Brave*.

**Artistic Creation (Character Animation & World Design):**
- Animators used multiple references: self-recorded video performances, voice actor recordings, and 2D animation drafts.
- A key goal was to avoid making animal characters feel like humans in costumes. They retained animal behaviors (e.g., Judy's ears rotating when alert, nose twitching when nervous, rabbit "binkies"; elephants using trunks; giraffes running with realistic gait).
- Animators visited Disney's Animal Kingdom and went on field trips to African wildlife parks.
- The city design (Zootopia) drew inspiration from San Francisco, London, and New York, with different climate zones.

**Fur Rendering:**
- A major challenge due to the variety of animals. Nick and Judy each required over 2 million fur strands; a giraffe needed up to 9 million strands. A new fur material pipeline was developed.

**Voice Casting Story:**
- Actor **Ke Huy Quan** (关继威) got the role of the blue snake **Gary** because an animator heard his voice in an interview, clipped the audio, and made a test animation that impressed the creative team.

**Directors and Producer:**
- **Jared Bush** (贾里德·布什) – Co-director and writer. Also worked on *Zootopia 1*, *Encanto*, and *Moana*.
- **Byron Howard** (拜伦·霍华德) – Co-director. Co-creator of the Zootopia world. Won Oscars for *Encanto* (2022) and *Zootopia 1* (2017). Over 25 years of experience including *Mulan* (1997) and *Klaus*.
- **Yvett Merino** (伊薇特·梅里诺) – Producer.
- All three won the 2022 Oscar for Best Animated Feature for *Encanto*.

#### [Seems that this film will become overrated as time goes on](https://m.imdb.com/title/tt26443597/reviews/?featured=rw11176939&ref_=tt_ururv_c_2_hd)

I watched Zootopia 2 as someone who experienced the first film in theaters and connected with its characters, themes, and heart. This sequel is not a bad movie, but for me, it is a mixed bag.

Seeing Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde again genuinely made me happy. The characters are still charming, the world of Zootopia is alive, and the snake storyline had potential, and musically, Shakira's new song is actually the one element I found stronger than anything in the first film - "Zoo" is even better than "Try Everything."

However, the biggest issue is the writing.

The movie repeatedly relies on a tired trope where the police misunderstand and chase the protagonists, even though Judy and Nick are police officers themselves. This happens multiple times and completely breaks the internal logic of the story. Instead of meaningful conflict within the system, we get forced misunderstandings that feel lazy and artificial.

There are also several recycled moments clearly designed to trigger nostalgia, such as gestures and scenes lifted from the first movie without adding anything new to the characters' development. At times, it feels like the film is afraid to let Judy and Nick grow beyond what they already were.

The "twist villain" didn't work for me either. It felt predictable, underdeveloped, and emotionally empty - especially since the first Zootopia already used this device more effectively. This sequel had the chance to go deeper and be bolder, but it chose safety instead.

What makes this more frustrating is that the movie clearly could have been better. The heart is still there, the characters are still lovable, and the world still has magic. But the script often settles for convenience instead of depth.

Zootopia 2 is enjoyable in the moment, but I don't think it will age as well as the original. While the first film still invites discussion years later, this one feels more like a pleasant revisit than a meaningful continuation.

I didn't hate it. I just expected more.

Rating: 6.5/10.

#### [Decent sequel, but not as good as the first one](https://m.imdb.com/title/tt26443597/reviews/?featured=rw11037147&ref_=tt_ururv_c_4_hd)

Zootopia 2 is a decent and mostly enjoyable sequel, but after such a long wait, it's hard not to feel a little let down. The original film genuinely surprised me with how clever, heartfelt, and layered it was. This follow-up brings back the familiar charm, but never quite captures the same magic. It mostly feels more like a safe sequel of a successful brand than a story that really needed to be told.

The movie still looks good with very solid animation and a few fun new locations, but the world doesn't feel as expansive or alive as it did the first time around. A lot of the action takes place indoors and the city itself just feels less imaginative than before. Story-wise, the mystery is serviceable but predictable, and the police-academy-style elements don't add much tension or excitement.

It's not a bad movie by any means. Judy and Nick are still likable. Their dynamic works and some of the new characters are entertaining as well. There are laughs, the message is clear and well-intentioned, and families will definitely have a good time watching it together.

Overall, Zootopia 2 is a perfectly fine sequel, but noticeably weaker and more derivative than its predecessor.

#### [What A Fun Trip To The Zoo-topia](https://m.imdb.com/title/tt26443597/reviews/?featured=rw10979765&ref_=tt_ururv_c_5_hd)

LIKES: The Animation The Adventure The Comedy The Voice Acting The New Song The Pace The Heart The References Summary: Disney has so much technology to animate at their hands, and it continues to show that off with this film. Smooth movements, a colorful design, and plenty of character in the motions, Zootopia 2 is a gorgeous display of what is possible with their resources, giving the audience plenty to look, gawk, and enjoy as the multi-biome city returns once more to the big screens. Within this environmental playground is an adventure that feels a bit bigger and more explored than the previous film's montage did. We dive into a few more secrets and environmental factors, playing around with the fauna that is indigenous to them, adapting to the needs as the wild adventure unsheathes its claws. It goes more down the traditional Disney route to teach lessons, but not be so in your face like the first film, which opens up a bit more of an escape from the real world. And helping to keep things fun is comedy that is present in so many forms that it's hard not to find some style to have you cracking up in the theater. Kids are going to become infatuated with a lot of the silliness invoked, and many of the parents will probably get pulled into the fervor with them and making many Instagram/TikTok videos to mimic them. My favorite part had to be the references. Like Wish, Zootopia 2 is ready to poke fun at Disney's work, and you'll find references abound within the two hours as another collective "cameo" menagerie is integrated into the movie. Mostly comedic, sometimes emotional, these references serve as another angle to enjoy the film for a geek like me. All of this is done at a decent pace, an adventure to follow in a manner that doesn't feel slow, and relatively keeps things in check to not be extremely fast you have no content.

The movie, of course, has plenty of emotional aspects with the Disney magical touch. A heartfelt film that digs deep into some hot topics, the monologues are sweet, sincere, and relevant to the new age of viewers. Bringing that to life (alongside the comedy) is stellar voice acting from an assorted cast who know how to bring such heart into their animated characters. Goodwin is always a command of emotions, bringing happiness and sadness in this genuine form that adapts to every scene with such sharp precision. Bateman is Bateman. That's not a bad thing, but his character didn't require as much spread across the emotional range. But he knows how to enunciate and manipulate his words to make the puns come to life, the jabs feel fun, and he really commands the comedic element so well. As for Quan, I loved him as the snake, genuine, cute, and somehow managing to embody his usual self in that snake form. I loved his little tweaks and had hopes they would have done a bit more with the film. In most cases, the delivery brings the heart this film needs, and I feel many will soften to the wonderful work they gave us with this film's content and performances. And if that's not your beef, then Shakira's new song has got a bit more flair, fun, and utilization as this zoo is ready to show you what it contains.

DISLIKES: The Predictability Some Overkill On Comedy Needed A Bit More Mystery/Suspense A Bit Overkill With References Missed Some Character Development Summary: Yet, the movie suffers from predictability, with many of the mysteries easily solvable within the first thirty minutes. Zootopia 2 is having so much fun that some of the stronger elements feel weaker in this film, diluted to be less intense for fear of being too much for the target audience. While I'm glad there was more adventure, I would have liked a little more magic, mystery, and suspense added to this to keep things on edge as to what would happen. Alas, I think Disney's focus on comedy and references may have gotten in the way of better storytelling. To put so much focus into these slapstick fests of clumsiness, goofy walking, and yammering by several characters into what will surely be a new trend, there just seems to be less focus on the older audience moments. Throw in that many side stories feel bland and pieced in, leading to too many subplots battling for relevancy, so that they seem to trip up each other to a small degree. And despite the hints of touching, the character development is surprisingly weaker than I had thought it would be. Don't get me wrong, there are still some elements that appear, but again, much of the sharing is a lot of references, comedic jabbering, and these shallower elements that I was surprised they pursued.

The VERDICT: Zootopia 2 is very fun, endearing, and an adventure that returns to Disney's era, where the adventure was just as important as the messages. Beautiful animation and voice acting work together to bring our buddy cup duo back to life, and I loved how well these were all integrated to make the tale come to life. With lots of comedic elements, a good pace, and references to scope out each rewatch, it's a film that will cater to a lot of audience members, especially the younger generations. Where the movie fails is getting too lost in that fun, silliness, and multiple stories, so that the elements of the first film feel a bit flatter than I expected. Character development is not missing, but doesn't lack the same intensity, nor does the mystery/suspense that also feels like kiddy gloves were pulled on for writing the story. There was more to unlock, discover, and fight, but the new era of storytelling/censorship still is a bit more prominent, and it's holding back some of Disney's strongest elements. Still, in the long run, the movie is a theater-worthy adventure for many reasons, and I encourage you to head out and give it a look if you can. My scores for Zootopia are: Mystery/Action/Adventure/Crime/Animated/Family: 8.0 Movie Overall: 7.0.

args.summary:
This is the IMDb page for the movie "Zootopia 2" (2025), the sequel to the original Zootopia. The film follows brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps (voiced by Ginnifer Goodwin) and her fox friend Nick Wilde (Jason Bateman) as they team up to crack a new, perilous case. The movie is directed by Jared Bush and Byron Howard, written by Jared Bush, and has a runtime of 1h 48m with a PG rating.

**Key Details:**
- IMDb Rating: 7.3/10 from 152K ratings
- Metascore: 73
- Nominated for 1 Oscar, with 20 wins & 90 nominations total
- Budget: $150 million (made back 130% in 48 hours)
- Available on Disney+, Prime Video (from $3.99), and other platforms

**Voice Cast:** Ginnifer Goodwin (Judy Hopps), Jason Bateman (Nick Wilde), Ke Huy Quan (Gary De'Snake), Fortune Feimster (Nibbles Maplestick), Andy Samberg (Pawbert Lynxley), David Strathairn (Milton Lynxley), Idris Elba (Chief Bogo), Shakira (Gazelle), Patrick Warburton (Mayor Winddancer), Quinta Brunson (Dr. Fuzzby), Danny Trejo (Jesús), and others including CM Punk and Joe Anoa'i.

**Soundtrack:** Features a new song "Zoo" performed by Shakira, written by Ed Sheeran, Blake Slatkin, and Shakira.

**User Reviews Summary:** Reviews are mixed but generally positive, with an average rating around 7/10. Reviewers praise the animation, voice acting, comedy, and the new song, but criticize the predictable plot, weaker story compared to the original, and recycled elements. Some noted it's a fun family film but doesn't capture the same magic as the first movie.

**Trivia:** The film made back 130% of its $150 million budget in just 48 hours. A post-credit scene hints at a potential sequel involving a feather, suggesting a bird-related mystery.

《**满江红**》（英语：*Full River Red*）是2023年中国大陆历史悬疑喜剧电影，由[张艺谋](/wiki/%E5%BC%A0%E8%89%BA%E8%B0%8B "张艺谋")执导，[沈腾](/wiki/%E6%B2%88%E8%85%BE "沈腾")、[易烊千玺](/wiki/%E6%98%93%E7%83%8A%E5%8D%83%E7%8E%BA "易烊千玺")领衔主演，[张译](/wiki/%E5%BC%A0%E8%AF%91 "张译")、[雷佳音](/wiki/%E9%9B%B7%E4%BD%B3%E9%9F%B3 "雷佳音")、[岳云鹏](/wiki/%E5%B2%B3%E4%BA%91%E9%B9%8F "岳云鹏")、[王佳怡](/wiki/%E7%8E%8B%E4%BD%B3%E6%80%A1 "王佳怡")主演；定于2023年1月22日[春节](/wiki/%E6%98%A5%E8%8A%82 "春节")上映。[[2]](#cite_note-dingdang-3)电影名称来自于[岳飞](/wiki/%E5%B2%B3%E9%A3%9B "岳飞")的词《[满江红·写怀](/wiki/%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2#岳飛 "满江红")》[[3]](#cite_note-4)。

《满江红》上映后，在中国取得商业佳绩，总票房突破45亿元人民币，创造张艺谋作品中国票房记录。

## 剧情

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=1 "编辑章节：剧情")]

[南宋](/wiki/%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%8B "南宋")[绍兴](/wiki/%E7%B4%B9%E8%88%88_(%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%8B) "绍兴 (南宋)")年间，[岳飞](/wiki/%E5%B2%B3%E9%A3%9E "岳飞")死后四年，[秦桧](/wiki/%E7%A7%A6%E6%A1%A7 "秦桧")率兵与[金国](/wiki/%E9%87%91%E5%9B%BD "金国")会谈。会谈前夜，金国使者死在宰相驻地，所携密信也不翼而飞。小兵张大（沈腾 饰）与亲兵营副统领孙均（易烊千玺 饰）机缘巧合被裹挟进这巨大阴谋之中，宰相秦桧（雷佳音 饰）命两人限一个时辰之内找到凶手。伴随危机四伏的深入调查，宰相府总管何立（张译 饰）、副总管武义淳（岳云鹏 饰）、舞姬瑶琴（王佳怡 饰）等人卷入局中，案件的背后似乎隐藏着一场更大的阴谋。局中有局、人心叵测，一夜之间风云变幻，各方势力暗流涌动……

## 制作

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=3 "编辑章节：制作")]

本片于2022年6月26日官宣开机。[[4]](#cite_note-5)同年8月结束拍摄杀青。[[5]](#cite_note-6)本片的取景地为山西省[太原古县城](/wiki/%E5%A4%AA%E5%8E%9F%E5%8F%A4%E5%8E%BF%E5%9F%8E "太原古县城")。[[6]](#cite_note-7)[[7]](#cite_note-8)

## 发行

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=4 "编辑章节：发行")]

2022年11月11日亮相[第31届金鸡百花电影节](/wiki/%E7%AC%AC31%E5%B1%8A%E9%87%91%E9%B8%A1%E7%99%BE%E8%8A%B1%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%8A%82 "第31届金鸡百花电影节")推介会。[[8]](#cite_note-9)同年12月27日发布预告片，并宣布定档2023年大年初一。[[2]](#cite_note-dingdang-3)同年12月29日官宣演员全阵容。[[9]](#cite_note-10)2023年1月5月公布全员角色名。[[10]](#cite_note-11)2023年3月2日在香港、澳门上映。[[11]](#cite_note-12)2023年3月17日，在美国上映。

## 反响

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=5 "编辑章节：反响")]

本片上映后，引发了游客游岳庙的热潮。2023年1月25日，[汤阴县](/wiki/%E6%B1%A4%E9%98%B4%E5%8E%BF "汤阴县")向全国游客推出出游福利，凡在[岳飞庙](/wiki/%E6%B1%A4%E9%98%B4%E5%B2%B3%E9%A3%9E%E5%BA%99 "汤阴岳飞庙")景区入门处熟练背诵《满江红》的游客，可免费游岳飞庙景区；凭全市各影院观看电影《满江红》票据参观景区，首道门票可按10元优惠价购买（原价38元）[[12]](#cite_note-13)。而[杭州岳王庙](/wiki/%E6%9D%AD%E5%B7%9E%E5%B2%B3%E7%8E%8B%E5%BA%99 "杭州岳王庙")也迎来大量游客到访[[13]](#cite_note-14)。同时有大量游客排长队，在河南省淮阳古城北龙湖之畔的[太昊伏羲陵](/w/index.php?title=%E5%A4%AA%E6%98%8A%E4%BC%8F%E7%BE%B2%E9%99%B5&action=edit&redlink=1 "太昊伏羲陵（页面不存在）")打“[秦桧](/wiki/%E7%A7%A6%E6%A1%A7 "秦桧")”。[[14]](#cite_note-15)

### 票房

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=6 "编辑章节：票房")]

中国大陆上映首日（2023年1月22日）票房突破3亿元人民币[[15]](#cite_note-16)，上映2天票房破8亿元人民币[[16]](#cite_note-17)。1月26日，实时票房破20亿元人民币。[[17]](#cite_note-18)1月29日上映8天，票房破30亿元人民币，成为[中国内地电影票房](/wiki/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E5%86%85%E5%9C%B0%E6%9C%80%E9%AB%98%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E7%A5%A8%E6%88%BF%E6%94%B6%E5%85%A5%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8 "中国内地最高电影票房收入列表")第16部破30亿的电影。[[18]](#cite_note-19)2月6日上映16天，票房破40亿元人民币，成为内地票房第9部40亿电影。[[19]](#cite_note-20)3月10日，票房突破45亿元人民币，成为[内地最高最高电影票房排行榜](/wiki/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E5%86%85%E5%9C%B0%E6%9C%80%E9%AB%98%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E7%A5%A8%E6%88%BF%E6%94%B6%E5%85%A5%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8#最高电影票房排行榜 "中国内地最高电影票房收入列表")第6名。[[20]](#cite_note-21)截止至2026年6月，位居中国大陆影史第8名。

## 争议

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2_(2023%E5%B9%B4%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1)&action=edit&section=8 "编辑章节：争议")]

2023年1月24日，一名微博用户在[新浪微博](/wiki/%E6%96%B0%E6%B5%AA%E5%BE%AE%E5%8D%9A "新浪微博")上发表了图片，图中显示该用户在线上购买了同为2023年中国大陆[春节档](/wiki/%E6%98%A5%E8%8A%82%E6%A1%A3 "春节档")电影《[流浪地球2](/wiki/%E6%B5%81%E6%B5%AA%E5%9C%B0%E7%90%832 "流浪地球2")》的电影票，却被影院方以“设备故障”为由取消放映并退款。但该用户发现被取消的场次并没有中止放映，而是放映了电影《满江红》。该微博迅速引发关注，不少网友表示该现象较为普遍，甚至有网友认为电影院此举是片方“资本操控”并质疑票房造假[[21]](#cite_note-22)。1月26日，《满江红》制作方在官方微博发布声明，称对于《满江红》所被指责诸如“幽灵场”“偷票房”“买票房”“资本操控”“抄袭”等均为无稽之谈，并将通过法律手段维护片方权益[[22]](#cite_note-23)。

该片电影海报出现多处繁体字误用，宣传文案出现诸如“不忘靖‘康耻’”的语言表达问题，书法使用不合影片主题的[瘦金体](/wiki/%E7%98%A6%E9%87%91%E4%BD%93 "瘦金体")引发争议。《[文汇报](/wiki/%E6%96%87%E6%B1%87%E6%8A%A5_(%E4%B8%8A%E6%B5%B7) "文汇报 (上海)")》评论员黄启哲批评电影的宣发缺乏常识，电影官方微博的宣传文案“看似精致华美，却莫名其妙的文案，全然不顾文史与逻辑常识”[[23]](#cite_note-24)。片方后移除了争议文案，并更换了字体。[[24]](#cite_note-25)[[25]](#cite_note-26)

2023年2月13日，一众筹网站发布了“电影《满江红》官方授权周边衍生品”项目。网站显示，该项目的基础目标金额为10万元，若众筹金额超30万元，将赠送Q版书签一套，超60万元将解锁“御赐令牌”，满100万元可解锁神秘赠品。其中“令”牌香薰扩香石，是以电影中主角张大所使用的令牌为原型按照1:1比例制作的，但上面写有“宰相通令，全军提调”的字样，在影片中也是秦桧赐给张大查案的信物；而“瑶琴”“青梅”是惨死秦桧手中的两个歌女的名字。而以电影场景中的中式大院元素设计的“红了樱桃”创意沙漏，其造型也被认为容易让人联想到岳飞被冤死的“风波亭”。另有网民指出，解锁福利有Q版秦桧的书签。这些衍生产品引发网民批评，认为“是在萌化秦桧”。2月14日，《满江红》周边活动表示，称由于产品设计和创意初衷与部分网友理解存在偏差，给网络舆论带来不好影响，对此深表歉意，决定下架众筹活动。[[26]](#cite_note-27)

args.key_excerpts: 《满江红》是2023年中国大陆历史悬疑喜剧电影，由张艺谋执导，沈腾、易烊千玺领衔主演，张译、雷佳音、岳云鹏、王佳怡主演，定于2023年1月22日春节上映，电影名称来自于岳飞的词《满江红·写怀》。,上映后在中国取得商业佳绩，总票房突破45亿元人民币，创造张艺谋作品中国票房记录。,2023年1月24日，一名微博用户发现购买了《流浪地球2》电影票被影院以设备故障为由取消放映并退款，但被取消的场次却放映了《满江红》，质疑票房造假。1月26日，《满江红》制作方发布声明，称对于指责均为无稽之谈，将通过法律手段维护权益。,该片电影海报出现多处繁体字误用，宣传文案出现诸如"不忘靖'康耻'"的语言表达问题，书法使用不合影片主题的瘦金体引发争议。,2023年2月13日，众筹网站发布"电影《满江红》官方授权周边衍生品"项目，因产品设计被认为"萌化秦桧"引发网民批评，2月14日片方下架众筹活动。
args.summary:
《满江红》（英语：Full River Red）是2023年由中国导演张艺谋执导的历史悬疑喜剧电影，片名取自岳飞的词《满江红·写怀》。影片由沈腾、易烊千玺领衔主演，张译、雷佳音、岳云鹏、王佳怡等主演，于2023年1月22日（春节）在中国大陆上映。

影片背景设定在南宋绍兴年间，岳飞死后四年，金国使者死在宰相秦桧驻地，密信不翼而飞。小兵张大（沈腾饰）与亲兵营副统领孙均（易烊千玺饰）被卷入阴谋，秦桧（雷佳音饰）命他们一个时辰内找到凶手。宰相府总管何立（张译饰）、副总管武义淳（岳云鹏饰）、舞姬瑶琴（王佳怡饰）等人相继卷入，案件背后隐藏着更大的阴谋。

电影制作于2022年6月开机，8月杀青，取景于山西太原古县城。影片预算5亿人民币，上映后取得巨大商业成功，总票房突破45亿人民币，创下张艺谋作品中国票房纪录，位居中国内地影史票房第8名。票房方面，首日破3亿，2天破8亿，8天破30亿，16天破40亿。

奖项方面，影片获得第18届中国长春电影节金鹿奖最佳导演提名、最佳男演员（易烊千玺获奖）、最佳女演员提名，第10届丝绸之路国际电影节最佳导演奖（张艺谋获奖），以及第36届中国电影金鸡奖最佳男配角、最佳音乐提名等。

影片引发多项争议：包括被指"幽灵场"、"偷票房"等（片方否认并称将通过法律维权）；电影海报出现繁体字误用、宣传文案断句错误等问题（片方后移除争议文案并更换字体）；以及官方周边衍生品因涉及"萌化秦桧"等争议而下架众筹活动。

The webpage is a Baidu Baike (encyclopedia) entry for the 2023 Chinese film **《满江红》 (Full River Red)**, directed by renowned filmmaker **Zhang Yimou (张艺谋)**. The film is a historical suspense comedy-drama set in the Southern Song dynasty, starring **Shen Teng (沈腾)** and **Jackson Yee (易烊千玺)**.

**Key Details:**
- **Director:** Zhang Yimou; **Writers:** Chen Yu, Zhang Yimou; **Composer:** Han Hong (韩红)
- **Cast includes:** Shen Teng, Jackson Yee, Lei Jiayin, Zhang Yi, Yue Yunpeng, Wang Jiayi
- **Production companies:** Beijing Huanxi Shouying Culture, Maoyan, Beijing Enlight Pictures, China Film Group, Beijing Kaihua Mahua, etc.
- **Release dates:** China Mainland - Jan 22, 2023; Hong Kong - Mar 2, 2023; North America - Mar 17, 2023; Singapore/Malaysia - Mar 23, 2023; South Korea - Oct 11, 2023

**Box Office Performance:**
The film was a massive commercial success, ultimately grossing **45.44 billion RMB (approx. 6.67 billion USD)**, making it the **6th highest-grossing film in Chinese film history**. It achieved rapid milestones: over 3 billion RMB in pre-sales, crossed 10 billion on Day 1, 40 billion by Day 16, and 45 billion by Day 42.

**Awards & Recognition:**
The film won numerous awards, including: Weibo Movie Night's "Film of the Year" (2022 & 2023), Golden Rooster Award nominations (Best Supporting Actor, Best Music), Changchun Film Festival Best Actor (Jackson Yee), Silk Road International Film Festival Best Director (Zhang Yimou), and was nominated for the Hong Kong Film Awards (Best Asian Chinese Film) and the Hundred Flowers Awards.

**Soundtrack:**
Han Hong composed the score. Key songs include "Jin Ye Wu Mian" (New Year promotion - sung by Shen Teng & Jackson Yee), "Man Jiang Hong" (title track - sung by Han Hong), and "Wang" (end credits - sung by Han Hong). A 31-track original soundtrack album was released on Jan 24, 2023.

**Ratings:**
- Douban: 7.0/10 (1,075,706 ratings)
- Mtime: 7.4/10
- IMDB: 6.5/10

**Other info:** The film was released on streaming platforms Tencent Video and Youku on April 28, 2023, and aired on CCTV6 movie channel from Oct 2023 onwards.

args.summary: This is a Baidu Baike (Chinese encyclopedia) entry for Zhang Yimou (张艺谋), the renowned Chinese film director, cinematographer, and artistic director. The page covers his early life including his birth, rural work experience, purchasing his first camera, and entering the Beijing Film Academy. His career is divided into phases: starting stage, rural period (films like Red Sorghum, Ju Dou, Raise the Red Lantern, To Live), thematic expansion (Keep Cool, Not One Less), commercial breakthrough (Hero, House of Flying Daggers, Curse of the Golden Flower), diverse attempts (including directing the 2008 Beijing Olympics opening ceremony), and continued high productivity (Shadow, Cliff Walkers, Full River Red, The Second Decree, etc.). His personal life includes family background and marriage. The page includes comprehensive lists of his directing works (from 1988's Red Sorghum to upcoming projects like Three-Body Problem, Hero League, and Jingzhe Wu Sheng in 2026), photography works, screenwriting credits, producing credits, and artistic direction roles. It also details his extensive awards record, including: 2023 Beijing International Film Festival Tiantan Award Lifetime Achievement Award, 2023 Tokyo International Film Festival Special Achievement Award, 2024 Asian Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award, 2024 Golden Rooster Award for Best Screenplay (The Second Decree), 2024 Hundred Flowers Award for Best Director (The Second Decree), 2024 Golden Deer Award for Best Director (The Second Decree), 2024 Hainan Island International Film Festival Lifetime Achievement Award, 2025 Huabiao Award for Outstanding Feature Film (The Second Decree), and 2026 Shanghai International Film Festival Outstanding Contribution Award among many others. His recent works include directing the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics opening and closing ceremonies.

# 满江红（京剧）

播报[讨论](https://baike.baidu.com/planet/talk?lemmaId=57246704&fromModule=lemma_right-issue-btn)[上传视频](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2%EF%BC%88%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%EF%BC%89/57246704)

2025年萧锋执导电影

[](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2%EF%BC%88%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%EF%BC%89/57246704)

《满江红（京剧）》是由[萧锋](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%90%A7%E9%94%8B/1025265?fromModule=lemma_inlink)执导，[于魁智](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%8E%E9%AD%81%E6%99%BA/421749?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[李胜素](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%9D%8E%E8%83%9C%E7%B4%A0/4583658?fromModule=lemma_inlink)等主演，[中国电影股份有限公司](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%82%A1%E4%BB%BD%E6%9C%89%E9%99%90%E5%85%AC%E5%8F%B8/9119953?fromModule=lemma_inlink)出品的京剧电影，复排改编[张永和](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%BC%A0%E6%B0%B8%E5%92%8C/3640431?fromModule=lemma_inlink)，为“[京剧电影工程](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E5%B7%A5%E7%A8%8B/23252116?fromModule=lemma_inlink)”的收官之作之一 [11]。影片于2021年获[国家电影局](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%AE%B6%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E5%B1%80/22811133?fromModule=lemma_inlink)备案（立项号影剧备字〔2021〕第1471号），2025年5月17日在中国大陆公映，并入围[第38届中国电影金鸡奖](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%AC%AC38%E5%B1%8A%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E9%87%91%E9%B8%A1%E5%A5%96/65587449?fromModule=lemma_inlink)最佳戏曲片，同年荣获第二十一届[中美电影节](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E7%BE%8E%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%8A%82/3114797?fromModule=lemma_inlink)“年度最佳戏曲电影”奖 [3-5] [16] [18-19]。

影片以[南宋](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%8D%97%E5%AE%8B/457341?fromModule=lemma_inlink)抗金名将[岳飞](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%B2%B3%E9%A3%9E/127844?fromModule=lemma_inlink)为主角，讲述其率军屡胜金兵却被[十二道金牌](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%8C%E9%81%93%E9%87%91%E7%89%8C/3363716?fromModule=lemma_inlink)紧急召回，最终遭“[莫须有](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%8E%AB%E9%A1%BB%E6%9C%89/877835?fromModule=lemma_inlink)”罪名诬陷，于[风波亭](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E9%A3%8E%E6%B3%A2%E4%BA%AD/4409406?fromModule=lemma_inlink)英勇就义的故事。剧情通过忠奸对峙等戏剧冲突展现岳飞精忠报国的精神，高潮部分与岳飞名作《[满江红](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%BB%A1%E6%B1%9F%E7%BA%A2/88?fromModule=lemma_inlink)》词章紧密呼应，作品创新融合传统京剧写意美学与现代电影叙事手法 [1-3] [19]。

## 幕后制作

播报

编辑

影片为“[京剧电影工程](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E5%B7%A5%E7%A8%8B/23252116?fromModule=lemma_inlink)”的收官之作之一，由[中国电影股份有限公司](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%82%A1%E4%BB%BD%E6%9C%89%E9%99%90%E5%85%AC%E5%8F%B8/9119953?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[国家京剧院](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%AE%B6%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%E9%99%A2/7260559?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[首都京胡艺术研究会](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E9%A6%96%E9%83%BD%E4%BA%AC%E8%83%A1%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF%E7%A0%94%E7%A9%B6%E4%BC%9A/24297813?fromModule=lemma_inlink)出品。 [8] [11] [14] [19]

导演[萧锋](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%90%A7%E9%94%8B/1025265?fromModule=lemma_inlink)认为，[电影艺术](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%89%BA%E6%9C%AF/17013514?fromModule=lemma_inlink)和戏曲舞台艺术看似截然不同，但“舞台上的虚实相生、时空自由、有无结合、天马行空等美学理论与电影的[蒙太奇理论](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%92%99%E5%A4%AA%E5%A5%87%E7%90%86%E8%AE%BA/4691561?fromModule=lemma_inlink)有很多相通之处”，他坚持京剧电影创作时要怀着对京剧艺术的敬畏之心，将电影的作用定位为锦上添花，并认为借助电影艺术的形式可以将京剧人物的心理活动进行多维度、形象化的拓展，形成强烈的视觉冲击力和心灵震撼力。 [11] [14]

制片人章慧霞介绍，拍摄过程中将京剧的写意和电影的写实相结合，大量使用电影视效制作，如《满江红》中的黄河岸边和风波亭等场景有力推动了剧情发展，同时导演与摄影反复推敲如何拍摄演员的每个细节，从台步眼神到水袖髯口，事无巨细。 [11]

主演于魁智表示，京剧舞台表演以程式化为特色，拍电影时需要调整表演以避免“过火”，使其更自然、更接近生活，虽然拍电影很辛苦，一勒头就是十几个小时，但觉得既辛苦又快乐；主演李胜素也感到拍电影时的表演要比舞台上更自然一点，更接近生活，也就是“稍微收一下”，她认为能够把演员最好的年华、最好的状态定格在大银幕上非常值得，于魁智和李胜素均表示把握舞台放大表演与电影自然表达之间的平衡对以后的京剧表演非常有帮助。 [6-7] [9] [11-12]

## 影片特色

播报

编辑

影片创新融合传统京剧写意美学与现代电影叙事手法，既完整传承戏曲程式之美，又借助光影技术增强视觉张力 [19]，既保留了戏曲的写意美学，又通过电影特效增强了视觉冲击力 [14]。导演萧锋认为舞台上的虚实相生、时空自由、有无结合、天马行空等美学理论与电影的蒙太奇理论有很多相通之处，制片人章慧霞介绍在拍摄过程中将写意和写实相结合，大量使用电影视效制作，如《满江红》中的黄河岸边和风波亭等场景有力推动了剧情发展 [11]。

主演于魁智和李胜素表示舞台艺术要放大表演，电影则要更自然、更接近生活地表达，把握两者之间的平衡 [6-7] [9]。复排改编张永和认为《满江红》拍成京剧电影后，更加拉近了与时代的距离 [9]。影片在资深戏迷与青少年观众中引起关注，其内容涉及家国情怀主题 [14-15]。

2025年4月21日，京剧电影《满江红》在[第十五届北京国际电影节](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E7%AC%AC%E5%8D%81%E4%BA%94%E5%B1%8A%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%8A%82/64989368?fromModule=lemma_inlink)“[京剧电影工程](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E5%B7%A5%E7%A8%8B/23252116?fromModule=lemma_inlink)”影片展映中，于[中国电影博物馆](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E5%8D%9A%E7%89%A9%E9%A6%86/3744432?fromModule=lemma_inlink)举办了首映新闻发布会和首映礼 [6-8] [12-13]。活动由[中国电影股份有限公司](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1%E8%82%A1%E4%BB%BD%E6%9C%89%E9%99%90%E5%85%AC%E5%8F%B8/9119953?fromModule=lemma_inlink)、[国家京剧院](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9B%BD%E5%AE%B6%E4%BA%AC%E5%89%A7%E9%99%A2/7260559?fromModule=lemma_inlink)等单位主办，中国电影股份有限公司副总经理任月、国家京剧院院长王勇等嘉宾出席 [9] [14]。

中国电影股份有限公司计划从2025年4月底开始，率领119家控股影院发起全国范围内的京剧电影长线放映活动 [14-15]。

首映礼上，主演于魁智、李胜素等登台与观众交流，分享了京剧电影拍摄与舞台表演的不同体验 [6-9] [12] [15]。于魁智表示：“舞台艺术要放大表演，电影则要更自然、更接近生活地表达，把握两者之间的平衡，对我们以后的京剧表演也非常有帮助。” [6-7] [9] [12]李胜素也表达了类似观点，并认为拍摄电影对京剧表演有所启发 [9] [11]。

2025年11月，该片在第二十一届中美电影节上荣获“年度最佳戏曲电影”奖 [19]。

args.key_excerpts: 影片创新融合传统京剧写意美学与现代电影叙事手法，既完整传承戏曲程式之美，又借助光影技术增强视觉张力, 导演萧锋认为，电影艺术和戏曲舞台艺术看似截然不同，但"舞台上的虚实相生、时空自由、有无结合、天马行空等美学理论与电影的蒙太奇理论有很多相通之处", 主演于魁智表示，京剧舞台表演以程式化为特色，拍电影时需要调整表演以避免"过火"，使其更自然、更接近生活, 制片人章慧霞介绍，拍摄过程中将京剧的写意和电影的写实相结合，大量使用电影视效制作
args.summary: 《满江红（京剧）》是一部2025年上映的京剧电影，由萧锋执导，于魁智、李胜素、杨赤、江其虎等主演，中国电影股份有限公司出品，属于"京剧电影工程"的收官之作之一。影片于2021年获国家电影局备案，2025年5月17日在中国大陆公映。影片以南宋抗金名将岳飞为主角，讲述其率军屡胜金兵却被十二道金牌召回，最终遭"莫须有"罪名诬陷，于风波亭英勇就义的故事。剧情通过忠奸对峙展现岳飞精忠报国的精神，高潮部分与岳飞名作《满江红》词章紧密呼应。影片创新融合传统京剧写意美学与现代电影叙事手法，将京剧的写意与电影的写实相结合，大量使用电影视效制作。主演于魁智饰演岳飞，他在拍摄中调整了舞台表演的程式化风格，使其更自然、更接近生活。影片于2025年获第38届中国电影金鸡奖最佳戏曲片提名，同年荣获第二十一届中美电影节"年度最佳戏曲电影"奖。

《**唐人街探案3**》（英語：*Detective Chinatown 3*）是一部於2021年上映的中國大陸[懸疑](/wiki/%E6%87%B8%E7%96%91 "懸疑")[喜劇電影](/wiki/%E5%96%9C%E5%8A%87%E9%9B%BB%E5%BD%B1 "喜劇電影")，2018年電影《[唐人街探案2](/wiki/%E5%94%90%E4%BA%BA%E8%A1%97%E6%8E%A2%E6%A1%882 "唐人街探案2")》的續集。由[陈思诚](/wiki/%E9%99%88%E6%80%9D%E8%AF%9A "陈思诚")编剧并执导、[王寶強](/wiki/%E7%8E%8B%E5%AE%9D%E5%BC%BA "王宝强")、[劉昊然](/wiki/%E5%88%98%E6%98%8A%E7%84%B6 "刘昊然")、[妻夫木聪](/wiki/%E5%A6%BB%E5%A4%AB%E6%9C%A8%E8%81%AA "妻夫木聪")、 [托尼·贾](/wiki/%E4%B8%9C%E5%B0%BC%E5%98%89 "东尼嘉")領銜主演。该片是全球第四部、亚洲第二部全片使用[阿莱Alexa](/wiki/%E9%98%BF%E8%90%8AAlexa "阿萊Alexa")[IMAX](/wiki/IMAX "IMAX")摄影机拍摄的电影（全球第三部、亚洲首部全片使用IMAX摄影机拍摄的电影是由管虎执导的《[八佰](/wiki/%E5%85%AB%E4%BD%B0 "八佰")》）。電影於2021年2月12日（农历辛丑年大年初一）在中國大陸以IMAX、[杜比影院](/wiki/%E6%9D%9C%E6%AF%94%E5%BD%B1%E9%99%A2 "杜比影院")、中国巨幕和CINITY等形式上映[[2]](#cite_note-2)。電影上映後，儘管票房亮眼，但口碑呈現兩極分化[[3]](#cite_note-36Kr(2021-02-15)-3)[[4]](#cite_note-香港01(2021-02-16)-4)。最终获得票房45.23亿人民币，票房最高时总额位列中国内地最高电影票房第五名[[5]](#cite_note-5)，现为中国影史票房第八名。

## 剧情

继[曼谷](/wiki/%E6%9B%BC%E8%B0%B7 "曼谷")、[纽约](/wiki/%E7%BA%BD%E7%BA%A6 "纽约")之后，[东京](/wiki/%E4%B8%9C%E4%BA%AC "东京")再出大案。唐人街神探唐仁、秦风受侦探野田昊的邀请前往破案。“CRIMASTER世界侦探排行榜”中的侦探们闻讯后也齐聚东京，加入挑战，而排名第一Q的现身，让这个大案更加扑朔迷离，亚洲最强神探之间的较量則将展开。

## 花絮

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E5%94%90%E4%BA%BA%E8%A1%97%E6%8E%A2%E6%A1%883&action=edit&section=6 "编辑章节：花絮")]

* 影片中出现了不少经典歌曲，包括日本经典推理电影《[人证](/wiki/%E4%BA%BA%E6%80%A7%E7%9A%84%E8%AF%81%E6%98%8E "人性的证明")》的主题曲《草帽歌》，[迈克尔·杰克逊](/wiki/%E8%BF%88%E5%85%8B%E5%B0%94%C2%B7%E6%9D%B0%E5%85%8B%E9%80%8A "迈克尔·杰克逊")的《[Heal the World](/wiki/Heal_the_World "Heal the World")》；
* 影片中的案发地居水堂，取景自日本[特别名胜](/wiki/%E7%89%B9%E5%88%AB%E5%90%8D%E8%83%9C "特别名胜")—[滨离宫恩赐庭园](/wiki/%E6%BB%A8%E7%A6%BB%E5%AE%AB%E6%81%A9%E8%B5%90%E5%BA%AD%E5%9B%AD "滨离宫恩赐庭园")内的中岛的御茶屋；

## 發行

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E5%94%90%E4%BA%BA%E8%A1%97%E6%8E%A2%E6%A1%883&action=edit&section=7 "编辑章节：發行")]

《唐人街探案3》原定2020年農曆大年初一於中國上映，並創下預售開賣23小時票房即突破一億人民幣的紀錄，然而因春節前夕[2019冠狀病毒病](/wiki/2019%E5%86%A0%E7%8B%80%E7%97%85%E6%AF%92%E7%97%85 "2019冠狀病毒病")爆發，與該年度春節檔所有電影一同撤檔。2020年9月21日，万达电影宣布《唐人街探案3》拟延期至2021年初在中国大陆上映[[7]](#cite_note-7)。10月9日，发布新定档预告和“开门见喜”版海报，宣布将于2021年大年初一（2月12日）上映[[8]](#cite_note-8)。澳门方面则于2月13日上映，香港计划于2月20日开设優先場，25日正式上映[[9]](#cite_note-9)。

### 票房

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E5%94%90%E4%BA%BA%E8%A1%97%E6%8E%A2%E6%A1%883&action=edit&section=8 "编辑章节：票房")]

在中国大陆，由于受疫情影响延期上映，使得影迷对本片的期待度高，在豆瓣上“想看”榜位列第一[[10]](#cite_note-10)。截至2021年2月11日15时37分，该片预售总票房超7.74亿元人民币，打破此前由《[复仇者联盟4](/wiki/%E5%BE%A9%E4%BB%87%E8%80%85%E8%81%AF%E7%9B%9F4 "復仇者聯盟4")》创下的中国影史预售总票房纪录，同时继续刷新首映日预售纪录[[11]](#cite_note-11)。2月12日上映首日票房达到12.87億元人民币，位居2021年春节贺岁档首位[[12]](#cite_note-12)。截至2月14日下午，该片總票房超過23億元人民币，成為中國影史第22部20億票房電影，同時刷新中國影史最快破20億票房紀錄和中国國產電影單周票房紀錄，后者此前由《[戰狼2](/wiki/%E6%88%B0%E7%8B%BC2 "戰狼2")》的單周票房21.71億元保持[[13]](#cite_note-13)[[14]](#cite_note-14)。

args.summary:
《唐人街探案3》（英語：Detective Chinatown 3）是一部2021年上映的中國大陸懸疑喜劇電影，為《唐人街探案2》的續集，由陳思誠編劇並執導，王寶強、劉昊然、妻夫木聰、托尼·賈領銜主演。故事背景設定在東京，唐人街神探唐仁、秦风受侦探野田昊邀请前往破案，CRIMASTER世界侦探排行榜的侦探们齐聚东京，排名第一的Q现身让案件更加扑朔迷离。

本片是全球第四部、亚洲第二部全片使用阿莱Alexa IMAX摄影机拍摄的电影。电影原定2020年春节上映，但因COVID-19疫情撤档，最终于2021年2月12日（农历大年初一）在中国大陆上映，并在IMAX、杜比影院、中国巨幕和CINITY等形式放映。

票房方面表现极为亮眼：预售总票房超7.74亿元，打破中国影史预售总票房纪录；上映首日票房达12.87亿元；最终总票房达45.23亿人民币，位列中国影史票房第八名。然而口碑呈现两极分化，整体不如前两集，猫眼评分8.7分，淘票票评分9.1分。

主要演员阵容包括：王宝强饰演唐仁、刘昊然饰演秦风、妻夫木聪饰演野田昊、托尼·贾饰演杰克贾，以及长泽雅美、染谷将太、铃木保奈美、浅野忠信、三浦友和等日本演员加盟，还有刘德华客串饰演Q组织首脑。

The webpage is the Baidu Baike (Chinese encyclopedia) entry for the film "唐人街探案3" (Detective Chinatown 3). Key information includes:

**Basic Info:** The film is directed and co-written by Chen Sicheng (陈思诚), with producers including Shang Na, Sun Tao, and Yue Xiang. The screenplay is by Chen Sicheng, Zhang Chun, Liu Wusi, Yan Yining, and Xu Zihao. Cinematography by Du Jie, music by Wang Zongxian and Sa Ji, editing by Tang Hongjia, and action direction by Wu Gang.

**Plot:** The story follows Tang Ren (Wang Baoqiang) and Qin Feng (Liu Haoran) as they travel to Tokyo for a new case involving a mysterious murder in the Chinatown mafia world.

**Cast:** Major stars include Wang Baoqiang (王宝强), Liu Haoran (刘昊然),妻夫木聪 (Satoshi Tsumabuki), Tony Jaa (托尼·贾), Tadanobu Asano (浅野忠信), Zhang Zifeng (张子枫), and others.

**Music:** Original songs include "酷你吉娃" (Kunijia) by NZBZ, "恭喜发财2020" (Gongxi Facai 2020) performed by Andy Lau, Wang Baoqiang, and Liu Haoran, "Welcome to TOKYO" by J SOUL BROTHERS, "On My Way" by Sa Ji, and "Heal the World" by Michael Jackson.

**Release:** The film premiered in Thailand on February 11, 2021, and released in mainland China on February 12, 2021. It was also released in the Middle East, Africa, and Japan (July 9, 2021). It has been broadcast multiple times on CCTV6 movie channel from 2021 through 2025.

**Box Office:** The film was a major commercial success, though specific total box office figures are not listed in the raw text.

**Ratings:** 
- Douban: 5.3/10 (1,076,395 votes as of March 2, 2024)
- Mtime: 6.4/10 (3,003 votes as of March 2, 2024)
- Maoyan: 8.8/10 (2.38 million votes as of September 14, 2024)

**Awards:** Won the First Beijing Radio, Film and Television Spring Swallow Award for Outstanding Feature Film (October 2025) and the First China Annual IP Selection "Original IP Gold Award" in 2021.

**Production Companies:** Wanda Media, Golden Screen, Alibaba Pictures, China Film Group, and others.

**Visual Effects:** Special effects by Xu Mingjun.

《唐人街探案2》上戏选角，宋妍霏扮猩猩逗乐陈思诚

《唐人街探案2》将于2016年在美开机，导演陈思诚携刘昊然等几位主演来到上戏选角，而“选出真正具有喜剧天赋的新人”则是陈导此行的终极目标。考试共分三轮的，第一轮基本功考核，CC等六人顺利过关；第二轮“一分钟逗你笑”，考生须在一分钟内把评委逗乐，除挠痒痒外，用任何方法均可。邢菲扮演孕妇佟丽娅，陈思诚不为所动。轮到CC上场，她先发动温柔攻势，羞着脸求陈思诚笑一笑，陈导还是沉着一张脸；接着又爆发野蛮女友力威胁对方笑，可惜陈导根本不吃这一套；眼看一分钟快过去，CC把心一横，扮起了歪嘴歪脸的猩猩。这只母猩猩围着主人抓耳挠腮，一副“拜托拜托”的深情。观众席里已有人笑出声，陈导也渐渐绷不住了。猩猩放出最后大招，歪着脸傲娇地抬起头。陈思诚终于破功了，“噗嗤”一声大笑起来。

解放天性获赞，宋妍霏:我只想抓住机会

凭借扮猩猩的魔性表演，CC和邵明明一起杀进了第三局。本轮的题目为还原《唐人街探案1》经典片段，看完两人的演绎后，陈思诚认为邵明明背台词的痕迹过重，CC在天性解放方面要胜出一筹。尤其是冲刘昊然喊的那一句“我是你大姨妈”，完全颠覆了昔日的女神形象。“喜剧表演最重要的是真诚，要认真地揣摩人物内心。演员的最终任务是塑造人物，未来定要努力突破戏路。演员如果只能演一种类型的角色也只能是昙花一现，在这方面CC的表现更突出”，陈导进一步点评。老师和同学也一致认为CC实至名归:“我觉得挺棒的，给的招儿比较多，一看就是动过脑子的。虽然获得了好评，CC却宠辱不惊:“作为新人，我只想抓住这次机会，没有太多顾虑。”其实不只是这次表演，CC的努力大家都有目共睹，最美猪八戒至今仍令人津津乐道。而《唐人街2》的拍摄时间恰巧与女主角佟丽娅的生产期相撞，陈思诚会不会选择CC参演呢？我们拭目以待。 [1]

Please follow these guidelines to create your summary:

1. Identify and preserve the main topic or purpose of the webpage.
2. Retain key facts, statistics, and data points that are central to the content's message.
3. Keep important quotes from credible sources or experts.
4. Maintain the chronological order of events if the content is time-sensitive or historical.
5. Preserve any lists or step-by-step instructions if present.
6. Include relevant dates, names, and locations that are crucial to understanding the content.
7. Summarize lengthy explanations while keeping the core message intact.

When handling different types of content:

- For news articles: Focus on the who, what, when, where, why, and how.
- For scientific content: Preserve methodology, results, and conclusions.
- For opinion pieces: Maintain the main arguments and supporting points.
- For product pages: Keep key features, specifications, and unique selling points.

Your summary should be significantly shorter than the original content but comprehensive enough to stand alone as a source of information. Aim for about 25-30 percent of the original length, unless the content is already concise.

}

args.summary:
# 百度百科：唐人街探案2

## 基本信息
《唐人街探案2》是2018年由陈思诚执导的动作喜剧电影，属于《唐人街探案》系列的第二部作品。影片由王宝强、刘昊然领衔主演，肖央、刘承羽等参演，故事背景设定在美国纽约。

## 剧情概要
唐仁以结婚为理由将秦风骗到纽约，两人再次组合侦破一起离奇的"纽约五行连环杀人案"。所有侦探高手齐聚纽约，试图捕获案件的蛛丝马迹。案件涉及一名癌症晚期的法医，五个精心挑选的祭品，以及一场横跨纽约的"五行续命"炼丹杀局。

## 主要演员
- 王宝强 饰演 唐仁
- 刘昊然 饰演 秦风
- 肖央 饰演 宋义
- 刘承羽 饰演 陈英

## 音乐原声
- 主题曲《Happy扭腰》由南征北战NZBZ创作演唱，2018年获Fashion Pop时尚之夜最佳电影歌曲。
- 新春拜年主题曲《粉红色的回忆》由王宝强、刘昊然、肖央、潘粤明、小沈阳、张子枫共同演唱，改编自韩宝仪1987年原唱经典，歌曲在纽约时代广场拍摄舞蹈场景。
- 推广曲《摇滚唐人街》由汪苏泷演唱，融合中西方创作团队完成。
- 插曲《Welcome to New York》由泰勒·斯威夫特演唱。

## 选角花絮
2015年，陈思诚携刘昊然赴上海戏剧学院为《唐人街探案2》选角。演员宋妍霏（CC）在试戏中扮演猩猩逗乐陈思诚，最终获得参演机会。陈思诚评价其"解放天性"表现突出，具有喜剧表演的真诚。

## 相关评价与讨论
- 影片被评价为"开创了华语商业片新类型，完美平衡喜剧与悬疑"。
- 也有观点认为"将推理片拍成闹剧，是对本格推理的亵渎"。
- 有评论指出《唐探2》的核心故事与2002年电影《双瞳》存在多处雷同（杀人动机、现场符号、楼中道馆等）。

## 系列背景
《唐人街探案2》是"唐探宇宙"的重要组成部分，该系列包括三部正传电影及前传《唐探1900》（2025年上映，票房突破36亿元），以及后续计划中的《唐探番外·王者归来》和《唐人街探案5》（暂定2030年上映）。

## 早年经历

播报

编辑

陈思诚，1978年出生在辽宁省沈阳市的一个干部家庭，很小的时候就展现了活跃的文艺细胞。陈思诚家庭条件富裕、父母支持他并尽可能地为他创造条件。因为唱歌、朗诵、主持样样精通，所以其频繁现身在学校的文艺汇演上，同时其也是学校广播室的一名广播员。高一开始主持沈阳电视台“学生时代”节目。

陈思诚

1996年，考进

[上海戏剧学院](/item/%E4%B8%8A%E6%B5%B7%E6%88%8F%E5%89%A7%E5%AD%A6%E9%99%A2/0?fromModule=lemma_inlink)

args.key_excerpts: 2006年在电视剧《士兵突击》饰演角色"成才"，而被大众熟知。主演电影《春风沉醉的晚上》并获第62届戛纳电影节最佳男演员奖提名。2012年其自编自导自演的电视剧《北京爱情故事》大热，仅网络播放率就达20亿以上。2014年2月14日自编自导自演的同名电影《北京爱情故事》上映，影片在情人节首映当日就以1.02亿的票房成绩创下历史新高，2月16日，电影被新闻联播点名表扬。陈思诚位列中国导演票房榜第2名，总票房161.52亿。2025年11月15日，陈思诚、戴墨凭借电影《唐探1900》获得第38届中国电影金鸡奖最佳导演奖。
args.summary: 陈思诚是中国内地男演员、导演、编剧，1978年出生于辽宁沈阳。2006年因在电视剧《士兵突击》中饰演"成才"一角而广为人知。早年经历：自幼展现文艺天赋，1994年考入上海师范大学谢晋影视艺术学院，后进入上海戏剧学院，1999年因打架被上戏开除后，经推荐进入中央戏剧学院。演艺经历：2001年凭电影《法官妈妈》获华表奖最佳新人奖、大学生电影节最佳新人奖。2009年主演《春风沉醉的晚上》获戛纳电影节最佳男演员提名。2012年自编自导自演电视剧《北京爱情故事》大获成功，网络播放量超20亿。2014年同名电影上映，首日票房1.02亿创历史新高，票房突破4亿，被新闻联播点名表扬。2015年自编自导《唐人街探案》系列。近年执导《唐探1900》（2025年上映，票房突破36亿元），该片荣获第38届中国电影金鸡奖最佳导演奖（陈思诚与戴墨共同获奖）。陈思诚位列中国导演票房榜第2名，总票房161.52亿。个人生活：2014年与佟丽娅在大溪地完婚，2015年证实佟丽娅怀孕。

《**飞驰人生3**》（英語：*Pegasus 3*）是一部2026年上映的[中国](/wiki/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8C%E5%9B%BD "中华人民共和国")[运动](/wiki/%E9%81%8B%E5%8B%95%E7%89%87 "運動片")[喜剧](/wiki/%E5%96%9C%E5%8A%87%E9%9B%BB%E5%BD%B1 "喜劇電影")电影，《[飞驰人生系列](/wiki/%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F%E7%B3%BB%E5%88%97%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1 "飞驰人生系列电影")》的第三部。该片由[韩寒](/wiki/%E9%9F%A9%E5%AF%92 "韩寒")自编自导，[沈腾](/wiki/%E6%B2%88%E8%85%BE "沈腾")、[尹正](/wiki/%E5%B0%B9%E6%AD%A3 "尹正")、[黄景瑜](/wiki/%E9%BB%83%E6%99%AF%E7%91%9C "黃景瑜")、[张本煜](/wiki/%E5%BC%B5%E6%9C%AC%E7%85%9C "張本煜")、[魏翔](/wiki/%E9%AD%8F%E7%BF%94 "魏翔")、[沙溢](/wiki/%E6%B2%99%E6%BA%A2 "沙溢")、[范丞丞](/wiki/%E8%8C%83%E4%B8%9E%E4%B8%9E "范丞丞")、[孙艺洲](/wiki/%E5%AD%AB%E8%97%9D%E6%B4%B2 "孫藝洲")、[段奕宏](/wiki/%E6%AE%B5%E5%A5%95%E5%AE%8F "段奕宏")主演，于2026年2月17日（农历[大年初一](/wiki/%E6%AD%A3%E6%9C%88%E5%88%9D%E4%B8%80 "正月初一")）在中国大陆上映[[2]](#cite_note-2)。

## 剧情

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F3&action=edit&section=1 "编辑章节：剧情")]

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c0/2025_Lynk_%26_Co_02_IAA_2025_DSC_2308.jpg/250px-2025_Lynk_%26_Co_02_IAA_2025_DSC_2308.jpg?utm_source=zh.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](/wiki/File:2025_Lynk_%26_Co_02_IAA_2025_DSC_2308.jpg)

中速天梯车队使用的赛车基于[领克Z20](/wiki/%E9%A0%98%E5%85%8BZ20 "領克Z20")改装

[最后一届巴音布鲁克拉力赛落下帷幕](/wiki/%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F2 "飞驰人生2")，尽管辛地车队在赛事中夺冠，厂长仍然决定对工厂做停产处理，并将厂房内部复刻成“星羽汽修”的模样送给张驰和他的朋友们，张驰继续从事着[驾驶培训](/wiki/%E9%A9%BE%E9%A9%B6%E5%91%98%E5%9F%B9%E8%AE%AD%E5%AD%A6%E6%A0%A1 "驾驶员培训学校")工作。由于车队失利，叶经理被光刻车队抛弃，只能做网约车司机。

一天，张驰和孙宇强应邀与中速天梯车队技术部的安部长会面，安部长向两人介绍了SS1[辅助驾驶系统](/wiki/%E9%AB%98%E7%BA%A7%E8%BE%85%E5%8A%A9%E9%A9%BE%E9%A9%B6%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F "高级辅助驾驶系统")的优越性能，同时邀请张驰代表“赛车[国家队](/wiki/%E5%9B%BD%E5%AE%B6%E9%98%9F "国家队")”参加首届“沐尘100”拉力赛，并将SS1芯片送给了孙宇强。张驰被车队老板百强任命为车队队长，开始了车手选拔的工作。在这场云集各路赛车高手的选拔当中，曾在巴音布鲁克表现优异的林臻东、刘世豪、张驰、厉小海位列前四名，四人将代表中速天梯车队参加“沐尘100”排位赛半决赛。然而实际上，百强和安部长已经内定决赛由[赞助商](/wiki/%E8%B4%8A%E5%8A%A9%E5%95%86 "贊助商")的车手李伦和本队的车手迟海生出战，为了打消换人的争议，百强计划让四名车手在排位赛中输给对手，从而让选拔中排名五、六位的李伦和迟海生递补。

为了控制车速，百强唆使安部长修改[ECU](/wiki/%E7%94%B5%E5%AD%90%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E5%99%A8 "电子控制器")降低动力输出。不料在选拔赛上，中速天梯的技术人员将赛车的[涡轮](/wiki/%E6%B8%A6%E8%BC%AA "渦輪")换成可靠性不佳的旧款型号，导致张驰四人的赛车全部因为涡轮故障退赛。刘世豪和厉小海离开了车队，张驰也为车队垫底一事担下全责。林臻东通过朋友搞到了选拔赛的数据，告诉张驰其实早在选拔赛就有人试图操纵赛车的速度从而影响选拔成绩。与此同时，叶经理也找到张驰，暗示百强的权术，带着张驰找到百强。叶经理回忆在任职光刻车队期间，天梯科技也曾竞争过车队的赞助商，但因为天梯干涉主力车手的人选而作罢。张驰意识到决赛的车手其实早已内定，叶经理也道破所谓的“赛车国家队”本质上只是商业赛事的商业队伍。百强则表示无论是举办赛事还是研发赛车都需要天梯科技这样的大企业提供巨额资金，自己和张驰都是牺牲品。两人决裂后，百强在查看张驰办公室电脑留下的战术设计资料时，提示文件已被加密，随即发现张驰和林臻东已经以个人车手身份参赛。

“沐尘100”在发车后分为南北两条赛道，北线为柏油和砂石混合路面，南线为[柏油路面](/wiki/%E7%80%9D%E9%9D%92%E8%B7%AF%E9%9D%A2 "瀝青路面")。张驰的赛车使用全柏油[轮胎](/wiki/%E8%BD%AE%E8%83%8E "轮胎")进入北线，令对手不解。凭借轮胎优势，张驰在前30公里的柏油路面创造了90秒的领先优势，随即停车进行“Undercut”战术，将前轮改为砂石胎。与此同时，林臻东在南线与李伦缠斗，百强告诉李伦让位，让林臻东与前面的车手缠斗消耗。张驰的赛车进入砂石路面，剧烈震动导致前车盖突然掀起，视野严重受阻，被迟海生超过，又被后方对手连续撞击车尾。叶经理提示张驰对方车辆会用左侧车头撞击，张驰故意让出右侧，使得后车撞上石头翻车退赛。随后，张驰接连通过数个高速坡将前车盖甩飞。林臻东与对手缠斗导致前轮消耗严重，李伦借机超过了林臻东。张驰进入了最擅长的砂石弯道，百强要求安部长远程关闭张驰车上的SS1系统，安部长则表示SS1无法在这种恶劣的环境下工作，完全是车手个人的能力在发挥。同时，迟海生遵从SS8的提示放张驰[超车](/wiki/%E8%B6%85%E8%BB%8A "超車")，令百强大为恼火。进入最后的冲线阶段，所有赛车的性能已经到底极限，张驰告诉李伦手动提升胎压，共同压制其它对手；林臻东燃油消耗即将殆尽，决定利用最后的动力为张驰创造[真空](/wiki/%E7%9C%9F%E7%A9%BA "真空")带提升车速，之后还牺牲自己去阻击日本队其中一个车手；百强再次请求张弛让赛，但张弛仍严词拒绝。日本队车手白川哲也、张弛、李伦三辆赛车几乎同时冲线，但最终张驰获得了赛事冠军。

## 制作

[[编辑](/w/index.php?title=%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F3&action=edit&section=4 "编辑章节：制作")]

随着《[飞驰人生2](/wiki/%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F2 "飞驰人生2")》在2024年春节档取得商业成功，导演[韩寒](/wiki/%E9%9F%A9%E5%AF%92 "韩寒")及其团队随即展开了续作的构思[[4]](#cite_note-4)。该片基本保持《[飞驰人生2](/wiki/%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F2 "飞驰人生2")》的原班人马，同时亦有部分《[飞驰人生](/wiki/%E9%A3%9E%E9%A9%B0%E4%BA%BA%E7%94%9F "飞驰人生")》第一部的角色回归，大部分主要演员均与[沈腾](/wiki/%E6%B2%88%E8%85%BE "沈腾")一齐参与过综艺节目《现在就出发》与《[王牌对王牌](/wiki/%E7%8E%8B%E7%89%8C%E5%B0%8D%E7%8E%8B%E7%89%8C_(%E7%9C%9F%E4%BA%BA%E7%A7%80) "王牌對王牌 (真人秀)")》[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6)。

该片于2025年3月备案立项[[7]](#cite_note-7)，2025年8月在[上海](/wiki/%E4%B8%8A%E6%B5%B7%E5%B8%82 "上海市")开机，并于10月下旬杀青[[8]](#cite_note-8)。影片非赛车戏份大部分取景于[上海市](/wiki/%E4%B8%8A%E6%B5%B7%E5%B8%82 "上海市")[闵行区](/wiki/%E9%97%B5%E8%A1%8C%E5%8C%BA "闵行区")[[9]](#cite_note-9)，大规模发车场景拍摄于[青岛](/wiki/%E9%9D%92%E5%B2%9B%E5%B8%82 "青岛市")[流亭机场](/wiki/%E9%9D%92%E5%B3%B6%E6%B5%81%E4%BA%AD%E5%9C%8B%E9%9A%9B%E6%A9%9F%E5%A0%B4 "青島流亭國際機場")[[10]](#cite_note-:0-10)，夜间赛车则于[宁波石化区](/wiki/%E5%AE%81%E6%B3%A2%E7%9F%B3%E5%8C%96%E7%BB%8F%E6%B5%8E%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E5%8C%BA "宁波石化经济技术开发区")[镇海炼化](/wiki/%E9%95%87%E6%B5%B7%E7%82%BC%E5%8C%96 "镇海炼化")实景拍摄[[11]](#cite_note-11)。为呈现片中沐尘100拉力赛的极限风貌，摄制团队跨越[四川](/wiki/%E5%9B%9B%E5%B7%9D%E7%9C%81 "四川省")[甘孜州](/wiki/%E7%94%98%E5%AD%9C%E8%97%8F%E6%97%8F%E8%87%AA%E6%B2%BB%E5%B7%9E "甘孜藏族自治州")[九龙县](/wiki/%E4%B9%9D%E9%BE%99%E5%8E%BF "九龙县")、[青海](/wiki/%E9%9D%92%E6%B5%B7%E7%9C%81 "青海省")[德令哈](/wiki/%E5%BE%B7%E4%BB%A4%E5%93%88%E5%B8%82 "德令哈市")等多地，前往海拔4500米以上地区实景拍摄[[12]](#cite_note-12)。

此外，为了追求更好的视觉效果，剧组还进驻制作过《[流浪地球](/wiki/%E6%B5%81%E6%B5%AA%E5%9C%B0%E7%90%83_(%E7%94%B5%E5%BD%B1) "流浪地球 (电影)")》系列[[13]](#cite_note-13)的[青岛东方影都](/wiki/%E9%9D%92%E5%B2%9B%E4%B8%9C%E6%96%B9%E5%BD%B1%E9%83%BD "青岛东方影都")进行为期约一个月的封闭式拍摄，利用虚拟拍摄技术及机械臂转台，完成了大量高难度的赛车内部特写及碰撞模拟镜头[[14]](#cite_note-14)[[10]](#cite_note-:0-10)。

args.summary:
《飞驰人生3》（Pegasus 3）是2026年上映的中国运动喜剧电影，韩寒自编自导，沈腾、尹正、黄景瑜、张本煜、魏翔等主演，是《飞驰人生系列》的第三部。影片于2026年2月17日（农历大年初一）在中国大陆上映，片长125分钟。

**剧情**：最后一届巴音布鲁克拉力赛结束后，张驰从事驾驶培训工作。他与孙宇强受邀加入中速天梯车队，参加首届"沐尘100"拉力赛，但发现车队老板百强内定决赛车手。张驰与林臻东以个人车手身份参赛，最终张驰在激烈竞争中夺冠。

**票房**：全球票房达6.34亿美元（截至2026年3月30日），超越《F1电影》成为全球票房最高的赛车电影（不含《速度与激情》系列）。该片是中国2026年第7-11周票房冠军，也是2026年春节档预售票房冠军。

**制作**：2025年3月备案立项，8月在上海开机，10月下旬杀青。取景地包括上海闵行区、青岛流亭机场、宁波石化区、四川甘孜九龙县、青海德令哈等高海拔地区，并在青岛东方影都使用虚拟拍摄技术完成赛车特写镜头。

**主要演员阵容**：沈腾（张驰）、尹正（孙宇强）、黄景瑜（林臻东）、张本煜（记星）、魏翔（叶经理）、沙溢（百强）、段奕宏（安部长）、范丞丞（厉小海）、孙艺洲（刘显德）、胡先煦（刘世豪）、冯绍峰、张新成、李治廷等。客串包括F1车手周冠宇和世界拉力赛车手塞巴斯蒂安·勒布。

## 韩寒 - 百度百科人物简介

韩寒是中国著名作家、赛车手、导演和音乐人。以下是其生平与成就的关键信息：

**早年经历与职业发展：**
- 以写作出道，后发展为多元职业身份，涵盖文学、赛车、电影导演、音乐创作等领域。
- 作为导演，其作品包括《后会无期》（2014，票房6.28亿）、《乘风破浪》（2017，10.49亿）、《飞驰人生》（2019，17.16亿）、《四海》（2022，5.43亿）、《飞驰人生2》（2024）以及计划于2026年2月17日上映的《飞驰人生3》。
- 作为监制/艺术指导的作品包括《扬名立万》（2021）、《长空之王》（2023）、《浪浪人生》（2025）等。

**赛车成就：**
- 2004年：亚洲宝马方程式资格赛冠军
- 2007年：全国汽车场地锦标赛1600cc组年度车手总冠军
- 2009年：中国汽车拉力锦标赛N组年度总冠军
- 2012年：中国房车锦标赛年度总冠军
- 2016年：国际汽联亚太汽车拉力锦标赛暨中国汽车拉力锦标赛冠军

**文学与音乐创作：**
- 曾为朴树《平凡之路》、邓紫棋《后会无期》、陈绮贞《我喜欢上你时的内心活动》等歌曲作词。
- 2010年入选《时代周刊》"全球最具影响力一百人"娱乐类排名第二。
- 2010年第五届中国作家富豪榜第8位。

**演艺与个人：**
- 曾参加《快乐大本营》《吐槽大会》《晓说》《王牌对王牌》等综艺节目。
- 曾为动画电影《极速蜗牛》配音（2013）。
- 社会评价方面存在"代笔质疑"等争议话题。

**获奖记录：**
- 2019年福布斯中国名人榜第20名
- 2018年凭《乘风破浪》获第37届香港电影金像奖最佳两岸华语电影奖提名
- 2014年凭《后会无期》获华语青年影像论坛年度新锐编剧奖

<summary>
# 《哪吒之魔童闹海》(Ne Zha 2) - Wikipedia Summary

## Overview
《哪吒之魔童闹海》(also known as Ne Zha 2) is a 2025 Chinese fantasy comedy animated film, the sequel to 2019's 《哪吒之魔童降世》(Ne Zha). Directed and written by Jiaozi (Yang Yu), based on the Ming dynasty novel 《封神演义》(Investiture of the Gods) and the traditional Chinese mythological figure Nezha. The film was produced with a budget of 600 million RMB (approx. $84 million), making it the most expensive Chinese animated film to date.

## Release
The film premiered in mainland China on January 29, 2025 (Chinese New Year's Day). It was subsequently released in the US (February 14), Hong Kong/Macau (February 22), Singapore (March 6), Malaysia (March 13), Japan (April 4), and eventually in over 70 countries worldwide. An English-dubbed version was released in North America on August 22, 2025, distributed by A24 and CMC Pictures.

## Plot
After the "Heavenly Tribulation," Taiyi Zhenren preserves the souls of Nezha and Ao Bing. Without physical bodies, Ao Bing's soul is fading. The Dragon Kings, believing Ao Bing dead, attack Chentang Pass. Taiyi suggests Nezha and Ao Bing (sharing a body) undergo an immortal examination to obtain the Jade Nectar needed to restore Ao Bing's body. They go to the Jade Void Palace and meet Wuliang Xianweng, who tasks them with capturing demons. The film's twist reveals that Wuliang Xianweng is the true villain, using captured demons to make elixirs and framing the Dragon Clan. After a devastating attack on Chentang Pass (where Nezha's mother dies), Nezha breaks free from a "Heart-Piercing Curse" and transforms into a teenage form. Together with Ao Bing, he defeats Wuliang Xianweng, who flees. The Dragon Clan retreats to the deep sea, while Ao Bing decides to stay with Nezha.

## Production
- Over 4,000 people participated in production (vs. 1,600 for the previous film)
- More than 300 characters, 2,400+ shots, 1,900+ special effects shots
- Notable effects: "Dynamic Ink Rendering Engine" for the Dragon Palace, 60 billion characters in the final battle scene, a 3-second shot of 100,000 fish took 1.5 years
- 5 years of production time

## Box Office (Major Achievements)
- **Mainland China**: 154.46 billion RMB (approx. $21.6 billion); 324 million admissions
- **Global**: $2.259 billion total
- **Records broken**:
  - Highest-grossing film in mainland Chinese history (surpassed 《长津湖》 on Day 9)
  - Highest-grossing single-market film globally (surpassed 《Star Wars: The Force Awakens》 on Day 10)
  - Highest-grossing animated film globally (surpassed 《Inside Out 2》 on Day 22)
  - 5th highest-grossing film globally
  - Highest-grossing non-English language film globally
  - 64 consecutive days as daily box office champion in China
  - 113 records broken, 308 milestones achieved

## Reception
- **Douban (China)**: 8.5/10 (1.4M+ reviews)
- **IMDb**: 8.1/10 (12,000+ reviews)
- **Rotten Tomatoes**: 91% fresh (80 critics), 98% audience score
- **Metacritic**: 68/100 ("generally favorable")
- Chinese media praised the film's special effects, storytelling, and modernization of traditional mythology
- International media (BBC, Reuters, CNN, NYT) noted the film's role in Chinese nationalist sentiment and the shift in the global film landscape
- Criticized by some for perceived "nationalist" messaging and reliance on emotional family tropes

## Voice Cast
- Nezha (child): Lü Yanting (Mandarin), Crystal Lee (English), Mutsumi Tamura (Japanese)
- Nezha (teen): Jiong Sen Se Fu (Mandarin), Griffin Puatu (English), Toshiki Masuda (Japanese)
- Ao Bing: Han Mo (Mandarin), Aleks Le (English), Takeo Otsuka (Japanese)
- Lady Yin (Nezha's mother): Lü Qi (Mandarin), Michelle Yeoh (English), Sayaka Kobayashi (Japanese)
- English-dubbed version features Michelle Yeoh and was distributed by A24

## Streaming
Released on streaming platforms in China on August 2, 2025, setting records with over 13M reservations on Tencent Video alone.

It was led by Bona Film Group and the August First Film Studio.

Key details include:

- **Three Directors**: The film was directed by three directors working in parallel, not as a "collage film": Chen Kaige (handled macro historical perspective, characters entering Korea), Tsui Hark (story coherence, visual style, special effects), and Dante Lam (action scenes, war sequences). Producer Huang Jianxin served as supervisor coordinating between the three groups, which together had 16 sub-groups.

- **Why Three Directors**: Producer Yu Dong explained that no single Chinese director could complete such a massive war film in the required timeframe (winter shooting window). A single director would need at least 4 years.

- **Cast**: Wu Jing played Wu Qianli (company commander) and Yi Yangqianxi played his younger brother Wu Wanli. Yu Dong said the roles seemed written for them. Wu Jing initially declined due to a serious leg injury before accepting.

- **Creative Choices**: The film intentionally does not focus solely on real heroes like Yang Gensi or the "Frozen Company" (冰雕连), but instead uses the fictional 7th Company as a narrative thread to weave together real historical events and figures for a broader epic perspective.

# Summary of "The Wandering Earth" (流浪地球) - Moegirl Wiki Page

## Overview

**"The Wandering Earth" (流浪地球)** is a science fiction novel by Chinese author **Liu Cixin (刘慈欣)**. It tells the story of humanity's plan to move the entire Earth out of the solar system to escape the dying Sun. The short story was first published in 2000 in *Science Fiction World* magazine issue #7, winning the **2000 Galaxy Award for Science Fiction (Special Prize)**. It has been published in various collections, including by the Yangtze River Literature and Art Publishing House and the China Science and Technology Press.

## Original Novel

**Plot Summary:** The Sun is dying, becoming a symbol of death and terror. Rather than perish, humanity embarks on the "Earth Escape Plan" — installing massive Earth Engines on one side of the planet to propel the entire Earth as a giant ark toward a new home. The cost is enormous: art, ethics, common sense, and countless lives are lost. Doubt and suspicion spark rebellion, but the Sun's final extinction silences everything, and humanity sets out on a long wandering journey.

**Key Quotes about the Novel:**
- Professor Yan Feng (Fudan University): "This work is extremely moving. Some say if you haven't read this novel, you haven't read novels."
- Yao Haijun (Editor-in-Chief, *Science Fiction World*): Praises Liu Cixin's passion for science and technology, and his construction of grand cosmic-scale worlds.

## Derivative Works

### Film: The Wandering Earth (2019)

- **Director:** Guo Fan; **Producer:** Liu Cixin
- **Cast:** Qu Chuxiao, Zhao Jinmai, Wu Jing, Wu Mengda (the late actor)
- **Runtime:** 125 minutes
- **Release:** February 5, 2019 (Chinese New Year) in mainland China
- **Box Office:** 46.55 billion RMB (China)
- **Plot:** In the near future, the Sun is rapidly aging and will engulf Earth in 100 years. Humanity forms a United Government and proposes the "Wandering Earth Plan" — building 10,000 planetary engines on Earth's surface to push the planet out of the solar system over 2,500 years. In 2075, Earth enters Jupiter's orbit for gravity assist. Liu Qi and his sister Han Duoduo illegally leave the underground city, triggering a series of events as Jupiter's gravity causes global earthquakes and engine failures. A global "saturation救援" (saturation rescue) effort is launched to save Earth from falling into Jupiter.

**Major Awards (selected):**
- 32nd Golden Rooster Award: Best Picture, Best Sound Recording
- 9th Beijing International Film Festival: Best Visual Effects
- 26th Beijing College Student Film Festival: Best Picture
- 35th Hundred Flowers Award: Best Director (Guo Fan)
- Nominated for Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts Award: Best Asian Film

**Critical Reception (from Chinese media):**
- *People's Daily*: Praised the film's Chinese family values, heroism, dedication, and international cooperation, noting it breaks from Hollywood's "superhero saves the world" trope.
- *Economic Daily*: Highlighted the film's Chinese characteristics — "move mountains, fill seas, mend the sky" — reflecting the Chinese spirit of struggle against nature.
- Taiwan's *Wang Bao*: Noted the film's "Chinese philosophy" of sacrifice and family heritage.

### Film: The Wandering Earth 2 (2023)

- **Release:** January 22, 2023 (Chinese New Year); 3D version on September 15, 2024
- **Director:** Guo Fan
- **Cast:** Wu Jing, Li Xuejian, Liu Dehua (Andy Lau), Ning Li, Wang Zhi, Sha Yi, Zhu Yanmanzi

- **Plot:** A prequel to the first film, focusing on the establishment of the "移山计划" (Mountain Moving Plan, i.e., the Wandering Earth Plan) and events before the Jupiter gravity crisis (2075). It depicts the Space Elevator Crisis (2044) and the Moon Fall Crisis (2058), using a three-clear-line (Liu Peiqiang, Tu Hengyu, Zhou Zhezhi) + one-dark-line (MOSS) narrative structure.

## Key Themes

The page emphasizes that the film franchise retains the core theme of the original novel: humanity facing cosmic catastrophe, proposing unprecedented plans, and unwaveringly carrying out the great mission. The Chinese approach contrasts with Western sci-fi by emphasizing collective action, family bonds, and the Chinese spirit of "moving mountains" and "filling seas" — the belief in humanity's ability to change its fate through struggle.

This video (from channel "己千坊," posted November 26, 2025) covers the behind-the-scenes story of *Zootopia 2* (疯狂动物城2), which was released around Thanksgiving 2025. The video discusses the film's development timeline, animation software improvements, artistic creation, world design, voice casting, and the directors and producer.

**Development Timeline:**
- June 2016: Directors began internal discussions about a sequel shortly after the first film's release.
- February 8, 2023: Disney CEO Bob Iger officially confirmed the sequel was in active development.
- February 7, 2024: Bob Iger announced the official title and release date.
- The project took about 9 years from initial idea to release.

**Animation Software:**
- Traditionally, Disney used Maya for character animation. For *Zootopia 2*, they began integrating Pixar's internal animation software, **Presto**, alongside Maya. Presto was designed to be intuitive for traditional animators. The first film to fully use Presto was *Brave*.

**Artistic Creation (Character Animation & World Design):**
- Animators used multiple references: self-recorded video performances, voice actor recordings, and 2D animation drafts.
- A key goal was to avoid making animal characters feel like humans in costumes. They retained animal behaviors (e.g., Judy's ears rotating when alert, nose twitching when nervous, rabbit "binkies"; elephants using trunks; giraffes running with realistic gait).
- Animators visited Disney's Animal Kingdom and went on field trips to African wildlife parks.
- The city design (Zootopia) drew inspiration from San Francisco, London, and New York, with different climate zones.

**Fur Rendering:**
- A major challenge due to the variety of animals. Nick and Judy each required over 2 million fur strands; a giraffe needed up to 9 million strands. A new fur material pipeline was developed.

**Voice Casting Story:**
- Actor **Ke Huy Quan** (关继威) got the role of the blue snake **Gary** because an animator heard his voice in an interview, clipped the audio, and made a test animation that impressed the creative team.

**Directors and Producer:**
- **Jared Bush** (贾里德·布什) – Co-director and writer. Also worked on *Zootopia 1*, *Encanto*, and *Moana*.
- **Byron Howard** (拜伦·霍华德) – Co-director. Co-creator of the Zootopia world. Won Oscars for *Encanto* (2022) and *Zootopia 1* (2017). Over 25 years of experience including *Mulan* (1997) and *Klaus*.
- **Yvett Merino** (伊薇特·梅里诺) – Producer.
- All three won the 2022 Oscar for Best Animated Feature for *Encanto*.

《唐人街探案2》是2018年由陈思诚执导的动作喜剧电影，属于《唐人街探案》系列的第二部作品。影片由王宝强、刘昊然领衔主演，肖央、刘承羽等参演，故事背景设定在美国纽约。

## 剧情概要
唐仁以结婚为理由将秦风骗到纽约，两人再次组合侦破一起离奇的"纽约五行连环杀人案"。所有侦探高手齐聚纽约，试图捕获案件的蛛丝马迹。案件涉及一名癌症晚期的法医，五个精心挑选的祭品，以及一场横跨纽约的"五行续命"炼丹杀局。

# 《哪吒之魔童闹海》(Ne Zha 2) - Wikipedia Summary

## Overview
《哪吒之魔童闹海》(also known as Ne Zha 2) is a 2025 Chinese fantasy comedy animated film, the sequel to 2019's 《哪吒之魔童降世》(Ne Zha). Directed and written by Jiaozi (Yang Yu), based on the Ming dynasty novel 《封神演义》(Investiture of the Gods) and the traditional Chinese mythological figure Nezha. The film was produced with a budget of 600 million RMB (approx. $84 million), making it the most expensive Chinese animated film to date.

## Release
The film premiered in mainland China on January 29, 2025 (Chinese New Year's Day). It was subsequently released in the US (February 14), Hong Kong/Macau (February 22), Singapore (March 6), Malaysia (March 13), Japan (April 4), and eventually in over 70 countries worldwide. An English-dubbed version was released in North America on August 22, 2025, distributed by A24 and CMC Pictures.

## Plot
After the "Heavenly Tribulation," Taiyi Zhenren preserves the souls of Nezha and Ao Bing. Without physical bodies, Ao Bing's soul is fading. The Dragon Kings, believing Ao Bing dead, attack Chentang Pass. Taiyi suggests Nezha and Ao Bing (sharing a body) undergo an immortal examination to obtain the Jade Nectar needed to restore Ao Bing's body. They go to the Jade Void Palace and meet Wuliang Xianweng, who tasks them with capturing demons. The film's twist reveals that Wuliang Xianweng is the true villain, using captured demons to make elixirs and framing the Dragon Clan. After a devastating attack on Chentang Pass (where Nezha's mother dies), Nezha breaks free from a "Heart-Piercing Curse" and transforms into a teenage form. Together with Ao Bing, he defeats Wuliang Xianweng, who flees. The Dragon Clan retreats to the deep sea, while Ao Bing decides to stay with Nezha.

## Production
- Over 4,000 people participated in production (vs. 1,600 for the previous film)
- More than 300 characters, 2,400+ shots, 1,900+ special effects shots
- Notable effects: "Dynamic Ink Rendering Engine" for the Dragon Palace, 60 billion characters in the final battle scene, a 3-second shot of 100,000 fish took 1.5 years
- 5 years of production time

## Box Office (Major Achievements)
- **Mainland China**: 154.46 billion RMB (approx. $21.6 billion); 324 million admissions
- **Global**: $2.259 billion total
- **Records broken**:
  - Highest-grossing film in mainland Chinese history (surpassed 《长津湖》 on Day 9)
  - Highest-grossing single-market film globally (surpassed 《Star Wars: The Force Awakens》 on Day 10)
  - Highest-grossing animated film globally (surpassed 《Inside Out 2》 on Day 22)
  - 5th highest-grossing film globally
  - Highest-grossing non-English language film globally
  - 64 consecutive days as daily box office champion in China
  - 113 records broken, 308 milestones achieved

## Reception
- **Douban (China)**: 8.5/10 (1.4M+ reviews)
- **IMDb**: 8.1/10 (12,000+ reviews)
- **Rotten Tomatoes**: 91% fresh (80 critics), 98% audience score
- **Metacritic**: 68/100 ("generally favorable")
- Chinese media praised the film's special effects, storytelling, and modernization of traditional mythology
- International media (BBC, Reuters, CNN, NYT) noted the film's role in Chinese nationalist sentiment and the shift in the global film landscape
- Criticized by some for perceived "nationalist" messaging and reliance on emotional family tropes

## Voice Cast
- Nezha (child): Lü Yanting (Mandarin), Crystal Lee (English), Mutsumi Tamura (Japanese)
- Nezha (teen): Jiong Sen Se Fu (Mandarin), Griffin Puatu (English), Toshiki Masuda (Japanese)
- Ao Bing: Han Mo (Mandarin), Aleks Le (English), Takeo Otsuka (Japanese)
- Lady Yin (Nezha's mother): Lü Qi (Mandarin), Michelle Yeoh (English), Sayaka Kobayashi (Japanese)
- English-dubbed version features Michelle Yeoh and was distributed by A24

## Streaming
Released on streaming platforms in China on August 2, 2025, setting records with over 13M reservations on Tencent Video alone.

Key details include:

- **Scale**: The film set Chinese cinema records for production scale, investment, shooting duration, and cast/crew size. - **Script**: Screenwriter Lan Xiaolong (known for "The Legendary Life of Qin Qiang," "Soldiers' Sortie") spent 5 years writing a 130,000-word initial script, later refined to 60,000 words. The story centers on the fictional "Steel 7th Company" (钢七连), a unit previously featured in his works.

# Summary of "The Wandering Earth" (流浪地球) - Moegirl Wiki Page

## Overview

**"The Wandering Earth" (流浪地球)** is a science fiction novel by Chinese author **Liu Cixin (刘慈欣)**. It tells the story of humanity's plan to move the entire Earth out of the solar system to escape the dying Sun. The short story was first published in 2000 in *Science Fiction World* magazine issue #7, winning the **2000 Galaxy Award for Science Fiction (Special Prize)**. It has been published in various collections, including by the Yangtze River Literature and Art Publishing House and the China Science and Technology Press.

## Original Novel

**Plot Summary:** The Sun is dying, becoming a symbol of death and terror. Rather than perish, humanity embarks on the "Earth Escape Plan" — installing massive Earth Engines on one side of the planet to propel the entire Earth as a giant ark toward a new home. The cost is enormous: art, ethics, common sense, and countless lives are lost. Doubt and suspicion spark rebellion, but the Sun's final extinction silences everything, and humanity sets out on a long wandering journey.

**Key Quotes about the Novel:**
- Professor Yan Feng (Fudan University): "This work is extremely moving. Some say if you haven't read this novel, you haven't read novels."
- Yao Haijun (Editor-in-Chief, *Science Fiction World*): Praises Liu Cixin's passion for science and technology, and his construction of grand cosmic-scale worlds.

## Derivative Works

### Film: The Wandering Earth (2019)

- **Director:** Guo Fan; **Producer:** Liu Cixin
- **Cast:** Qu Chuxiao, Zhao Jinmai, Wu Jing, Wu Mengda (the late actor)
- **Runtime:** 125 minutes
- **Release:** February 5, 2019 (Chinese New Year) in mainland China
- **Box Office:** 46.55 billion RMB (China)
- **Plot:** In the near future, the Sun is rapidly aging and will engulf Earth in 100 years. Humanity forms a United Government and proposes the "Wandering Earth Plan" — building 10,000 planetary engines on Earth's surface to push the planet out of the solar system over 2,500 years. In 2075, Earth enters Jupiter's orbit for gravity assist. Liu Qi and his sister Han Duoduo illegally leave the underground city, triggering a series of events as Jupiter's gravity causes global earthquakes and engine failures. A global "saturation救援" (saturation rescue) effort is launched to save Earth from falling into Jupiter.

**Major Awards (selected):**
- 32nd Golden Rooster Award: Best Picture, Best Sound Recording
- 9th Beijing International Film Festival: Best Visual Effects
- 26th Beijing College Student Film Festival: Best Picture
- 35th Hundred Flowers Award: Best Director (Guo Fan)
- Nominated for Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts Award: Best Asian Film

**Critical Reception (from Chinese media):**
- *People's Daily*: Praised the film's Chinese family values, heroism, dedication, and international cooperation, noting it breaks from Hollywood's "superhero saves the world" trope.
- *Economic Daily*: Highlighted the film's Chinese characteristics — "move mountains, fill seas, mend the sky" — reflecting the Chinese spirit of struggle against nature.
- Taiwan's *Wang Bao*: Noted the film's "Chinese philosophy" of sacrifice and family heritage.

### Film: The Wandering Earth 2 (2023)

## Key Themes

The page emphasizes that the film franchise retains the core theme of the original novel: humanity facing cosmic catastrophe, proposing unprecedented plans, and unwaveringly carrying out the great mission.
